sentences.你的力量多放在內心世界，不輕易外露。: Your strength is mostly directed towards your inner world and does not readily show.

sentences.因此，不能只看行動力或輔曜便取正面結論。: You therefore cannot reach a positive conclusion from drive or supporting stars alone.

sentences.擴大投入之前，先確認原有成果有人維持。: Before committing more, make sure someone is maintaining what you have already achieved.

sentences.天府獨坐丑未，對宮廉殺，會天相及借會紫貪。: Tian Fu sits alone in Chou or Wei, with Lian Zhen and Qi Sha in the opposite palace, and connects with Tian Xiang and, through borrowing from the opposite palace, Zi Wei and Tan Lang.

sentences.你開始一件新事時，也替它安排好之後怎樣維持。: When you start something new, plan how you will keep it going.

sentences.你本身就帶權力的性質，這份力量用在正途，就是權威。: You have an inherent quality of power, and when you use it for proper ends, it becomes authority.

sentences.原書的權威與橫霸是兩個比較端點，也明說多數人並不走到極端。: The book uses authority and domineering behaviour as two ends of a scale, and explicitly says that most people do not reach either extreme.
sentences.紫殺同坐巳亥，對宮天府，會武貪與廉破。: Zi Wei and Qi Sha sit together in Si or Hai, with Tian Fu in the opposite palace, and connect with Wu Qu and Tan Lang, and Lian Zhen and Po Jun.

sentences.丑宮借未宮同巨則不同。: It is different when the palace in Chou borrows Tian Tong and Ju Men from the palace in Wei.

sentences.兩種方向都保留條件，並不是固定的地支標籤。: Both directions come with conditions; neither is a fixed label tied to a branch.

sentences.你屬沉穩的一型，較容易累積財力，撐得起自己的地位。: You are the calm, steady type, making it easier for you to build financial strength and sustain your position.
sentences.表現亮眼不一定已經穩妥，表現收斂也不等於缺少力量，不能只看太陽的光度。: An impressive outward showing does not necessarily mean you are on firm ground, and a restrained one does not mean you lack strength, so you cannot judge by Tai Yang's brightness alone.
sentences.原書指出，午宮太陽雖入廟，仍可能虛浮；子宮的四化作用又有不同。: The book points out that although Tai Yang has its strongest placement in Wu, it may still be superficial; the four transformations also work differently in Zi.
sentences.支持是否齊備、煞曜如何配合，比單看廟陷更重要。: Whether support is complete and how the harsh stars interact matter more than simply whether a star is in a strong or weak placement.
sentences.太陽獨坐子午，對宮天梁，會巨門及借會機陰。: Tai Yang sits alone in Zi or Wu, with Tian Liang in the opposite palace, and connects with Ju Men and, through borrowing from the opposite palace, Tian Ji and Tai Yin.
sentences.你性情偏沉潛收斂，孤僻的一面不容易化開。: You tend to be inward-looking and reserved, and your withdrawn side is not easy to soften.

sentences.你這組命宮把照顧交情與保留原則放在重點。: Your Life Palace highlights caring for your relationships and keeping your principles.
sentences.願意幫人，與不分情況便答應，是不同的事。: Being willing to help others is different from agreeing regardless of the circumstances.

sentences.夾宮的日曜或巨門、天府是否充盈，以及借會星系四化，都是需要分清的條件。: You need to distinguish the effects of Tai Yang or Ju Men flanking the palace, whether Tian Fu's storehouse is full, and the four transformations of the stars connected through borrowing.
sentences.你性情偏向祥和，與人相處較融和。: You tend to have a peaceful nature and get along more harmoniously with others.
sentences.原書較完整的統籌結構，除得祿外仍要求無煞、尤其無空劫。: For the fuller capacity to coordinate described in the book, support from Abundance must still be accompanied by an absence of harsh stars, especially Di Kong and Di Jie.
sentences.你這組命宮把物質與感情欲望的方向放在重點。: Your Life Palace highlights the direction of your material and emotional desires.
sentences.與其只問何時有成果，更值得先分清追求甚麼，以及哪些配合讓這份追求得到調整。: Rather than only asking when you will see results, it is more useful to first clarify what you are pursuing and which influences from the other stars allow that pursuit to be adjusted.
sentences.原書雖先談寅申早晚的分別，仍要求回到欲望本質。: Although the book first discusses the difference between earlier and later timing in Yin and Shen, it still requires a return to the nature of the desires themselves.
sentences.貪狼獨坐寅申，對宮廉貞，會破軍與七殺。: Tan Lang sits alone in Yin or Shen, with Lian Zhen in the opposite palace, and connects with Po Jun and Qi Sha.
sentences.你這組命宮把獨立的距離與人際融合放在重點。: Your Life Palace highlights the distance you keep to stay independent and how you fit in with others.
sentences.兩者可以同時存在，不能只因喜歡自己處理事情，就判作孤立，也不能由容易合作便概括整: Both can exist at once: enjoying handling things yourself does not by itself mean you are isolated, and being easy to work with does not sum up the whole picture.
sentences.原書先以對宮太陽光度作基本比較，再加入天梁、日月與其他星曜的四化修訂。: The book first uses Tai Yang's brightness in the opposite palace for a basic comparison, then refines the reading with Tian Liang and the four transformations of Tai Yang, Tai Yin and the other stars.
sentences.宮支是起點，並不代替整組配合。: The palace's branch is a starting point and does not replace a reading of all the stars together.

sentences.你這組命宮把內心感受與外在環境的拉扯放在重點。: Your Life Palace highlights the pull between your inner feelings and your outer circumstances.
sentences.需要理解的是，當要求改變時，能否承接壓力並作調整，而不是只用堅強或脆弱概括自己。: What you need to understand is whether you can bear the pressure and adjust when demands change, rather than simply describing yourself as strong or fragile.

sentences.原書因此談剛毅與脆弱。: The book therefore discusses resolve and fragility.
sentences.廉貞天相同坐子午，對宮破軍，會紫府及武曲。: Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang sit together in Zi or Wu, with Po Jun in the opposite palace, and connect with Zi Wei and Tian Fu, and Wu Qu.
sentences.你這組命宮值得留意的，是明快的決定背後，有沒有足夠考慮與轉圜空間。: With your Life Palace, what deserves attention is whether your brisk decisions have enough thought behind them and enough room for adjustment.

sentences.不能用作決定的速度，反過來證明是哪一類。: You cannot work backwards from the speed of a decision to prove which type you belong to.

sentences.不能把任一吉星當成完整的判斷依據。: You cannot base a complete judgement on any single favourable star.
sentences.你這組命宮把豁達與持續的方向感放在一起。: Your Life Palace brings together a broad outlook and a lasting sense of direction.
sentences.能放開一時得失，與稍有進展便停下，表面都可能不爭，卻是不同的狀態。: Letting go of temporary gains and losses and stopping after a little progress may both look uncompetitive on the surface, but they are different states.
sentences.天同獨坐辰戌，對宮巨門，會機陰及天梁。: Tian Tong sits alone in Chen or Xu, with Ju Men in the opposite palace, and connects with Tian Ji and Tai Yin, and Tian Liang.
sentences.你這組命宮的主題，是遇到變化時的靈活，能否連成有方向的計劃。: The theme of your Life Palace is whether your flexibility in the face of change can develop into a plan with a clear direction.
sentences.臨場想到辦法，與持續安排下一步，是兩種不同的用力方式。: Finding a solution on the spot and continually planning the next step are two different ways of applying yourself.

sentences.天機獨坐巳亥，對宮太陰，三合同巨及借會陽梁。: Tian Ji sits alone in Si or Hai, with Tai Yin in the opposite palace, Tian Tong and Ju Men in the linked palaces, and a connection to Tai Yang and Tian Liang through borrowing from the opposite palace.
sentences.同巨亦借入福德，所以原書先察它的感情色彩，再看陽梁與太陰怎樣影響天機。: Tian Tong and Ju Men are also borrowed into the Wellbeing Palace, so the book first examines their emotional quality, then considers how Tai Yang and Tian Liang, and Tai Yin, influence Tian Ji.
sentences.若你正考慮一個新方向，可以先試行其中一小部分，再核對時間、資源與自己願意承擔的代: If you are considering a new direction, you can try a small part of it first, then check the time, resources and cost you are willing to bear.
sentences.這是編輯提出的觀察方法，不是命盤替你決定去留。: This is a way of observing suggested by the editor, rather than your chart deciding whether you stay or leave.
sentences.你這組命宮有力道強、需要向前推動的主題。: Your Life Palace has a theme of strong force and a need to push forwards.
sentences.因此，不能用一個人的外表、努力程度，或一次情緒反應，反推整個命盤分類。: You therefore cannot work backwards from someone's appearance, level of effort or a single emotional reaction to classify their whole chart.
sentences.廉貞七殺同坐丑未，對宮天府，會紫貪與武破。: Lian Zhen and Qi Sha sit together in Chou or Wei, with Tian Fu in the opposite palace, and connect with Zi Wei and Tan Lang, and Wu Qu and Po Jun.
sentences.原書先看得祿，再看輔煞與四化的配合；吉凶因素同時存在，也不能直接相加抵銷。: The book first checks for support from Abundance, then examines how the supporting stars, harsh stars and four transformations interact; when favourable and unfavourable factors coexist, they cannot simply be added together and cancelled out either.

sentences.七殺獨坐子午，對宮武曲天府，會破軍與貪狼。: Qi Sha sits alone in Zi or Wu, with Wu Qu and Tian Fu in the opposite palace, and connects with Po Jun and Tan Lang.

sentences.只用保守或敢變其中一個形容，未能說清整個組合。: Describing you only as cautious or willing to change does not fully explain how these stars work together.

sentences.你是情緒型的人，帶藝術氣質。: You are an emotional person with an artistic temperament.

sentences.兩種反應會令變動呈現不同幅度，並非破軍坐命就一定經常換方向。: These two responses lead to changes of different sizes, and having Po Jun in your Life Palace does not necessarily mean you often change direction.
sentences.得到輔助不一定改變方向：有些輔曜只是把原有傾向加強。: Receiving support does not necessarily change your direction: some supporting stars simply strengthen your existing tendencies.

sentences.入廟而受煞刑忌耗侵擾，則可能轉向消極。: Even in its strongest position, a star may turn towards passivity if troubled by harsh stars, punishment, Obstruction and depletion.
sentences.生活情趣與原則紀律，是你這組命宮的兩個重要面向。: Two sides matter most in your Life Palace: enjoying life, and principle and discipline.
sentences.它們會影響去留與取捨，但同樣坐天同天梁，兩者的配合仍可以不同。: They influence whether you stay or leave and what you keep or give up, but even with Tian Tong and Tian Liang in your Life Palace, the balance between them can vary.
sentences.情趣、原則與能否調和，要連會合星曜與特殊配合一起理解。: Your enjoyment of life, your principles and whether they can work in harmony need to be understood alongside the stars that meet and their special arrangements.
sentences.感受與標準都在場時，如何讓兩者接上，是這組命宮的主題。: When both feelings and standards are present, finding a way to connect them is the theme of your Life Palace.
sentences.原書先區分情趣與原則，再另列特殊結構及調和的條件。: The book first distinguishes enjoyment of life from principles, then separately lists special arrangements of stars and the conditions for harmony.
sentences.你習慣照料身邊的人，替人解難。: You are used to looking after those around you and helping them solve their problems.
sentences.你這組命宮把承擔與負荷放在重點。: Your Life Palace centres on taking responsibility and the burden it brings.
sentences.太陽的力量如何回應其他星系的需要，會影響這組合的處境；不能只見太陽，就把照顧別人: How Tai Yang's strength meets the needs of other stars affects the circumstances of your Life Palace; its presence alone does not mean that looking after others should be taken for granted.
sentences.原書看的不只是太陽夠不夠亮，還包括太陰、巨門與同梁需不需要它的照應。: The book considers whether Tai Yang is bright enough and whether Tai Yin, Ju Men, and Tian Tong and Tian Liang need its care.
sentences.這是盤面關係的說明，並不表示現實中已有人拖累你。: This explains relationships within your chart and does not mean that someone is already holding you back in real life.
sentences.太陽獨坐辰戌，對宮太陰，會巨門及同梁。: Tai Yang occupies Chen or Xu alone, with Tai Yin in the opposite palace, and meets Ju Men and Tian Tong and Tian Liang.
sentences.陽梁同坐卯酉，會太陰及借會同巨。: Tai Yang and Tian Liang share Mao or You, meeting Tai Yin and, through borrowing from the opposite palace, Tian Tong and Ju Men.
sentences.擎羊的作用尤其要分子午：午宮的特殊格局與子宮的限制不同。: Qing Yang's effects need particular care in distinguishing Zi from Wu: the special formation in Wu differs from the limitations in Zi.
sentences.原來較積極的同陰，得輔佐與擎羊可受激發，卻仍有空曜同度等限制。: When Tian Tong and Tai Yin are more active to begin with, supporting stars and Qing Yang can spur them on, though limits remain, such as Di Kong or Di Jie sharing the palace.
sentences.你這組命宮把受牽制與受激發的差別放在重點。: Your Life Palace centres on the difference between being held back and being spurred on.
sentences.巨門獨坐辰戌，對宮天同，會太陽及借會機陰。: Ju Men occupies Chen or Xu alone, with Tian Tong in the opposite palace, and meets Tai Yang and, through borrowing from the opposite palace, Tian Ji and Tai Yin.
sentences.原書合看吉曜與適度刺激，並沒有把所有輔曜都視為能消除限制的支持。: The book considers favourable stars together with a suitable degree of stimulation, without treating every supporting star as help that can remove limitations.
sentences.火羊的激發也要連吉曜看。: The stimulation from Huo Xing and Qing Yang also needs to be considered alongside favourable stars.
sentences.廉貪同坐巳亥，會武曲七殺及紫微破軍。: Lian Zhen and Tan Lang share Si or Hai, meeting Wu Qu and Qi Sha, and Zi Wei and Po Jun.
sentences.你可以先分清自己真正想追求甚麼，不必因為別人的期待把目標定大。: You can first clarify what you truly want to pursue, without making your goals bigger because of other people's expectations.
sentences.選一個做得完的階段目標，完成後再看是否值得投入更多；需要別人一起做時，也按自己能: Choose a goal you can complete for the current stage, then decide whether it is worth investing more once you have finished; when others need to be involved, agree to a pace you can manage.
sentences.你這組命宮把開創與服務的方向放在一起。: Your Life Palace brings together breaking new ground and serving others.
sentences.原書關心這份行動是為共同職責，還是較偏向自己的利益。: The book asks whether your actions serve shared responsibilities or lean more towards your own interests.
sentences.你接下一項新工作或共同任務前，可以先說清楚自己為誰負責、要完成甚麼，以及哪些決定: Before taking on a new job or shared task, you can make clear who you are responsible to, what you need to complete and which decisions need agreement from everyone involved.
sentences.想開拓新做法，也先替原有責任安排好交接，讓開創有可以持續承擔的位置。: If you want to explore new ways of doing things, first arrange a handover of your existing responsibilities so that you have room to sustain the new work.
sentences.廉破同坐卯酉，對宮天相，會紫殺與武貪。: Lian Zhen and Po Jun share Mao or You, with Tian Xiang in the opposite palace, and meet Zi Wei and Qi Sha, and Wu Qu and Tan Lang.
sentences.原書按不同四化及煞曜、輔佐，分清開創的目的與付出方式，不單從廉破兩個星名判職業。: The book uses differences in the four transformations, harsh stars and supporting stars to distinguish the purpose of breaking new ground and how you contribute, rather than judging your occupation from the names Lian Zhen and Po Jun alone.
sentences.你身邊多有助力，遇事有人相幫。: You have plenty of support around you, with people to help when things arise.
sentences.你這組命宮把敏感與踏實作為比較。: Your Life Palace compares sensitivity with being grounded.
sentences.重視精神生活，與需要物質享受作基礎，可以有不同比重；不能把敏感等同脆弱，也不能把: Valuing your inner life and needing material comforts as a foundation can carry different weights; sensitivity cannot be equated with fragility, nor being grounded with caring only about material things.
sentences.原書由廉貞與對宮貪狼的四化，再看文藝、桃花及輔佐諸曜修訂。: The book starts with the four transformations of Lian Zhen and Tan Lang in the opposite palace, then refines its reading through stars associated with the arts, romance and support.
sentences.較重精神生活是一個理解方向，不代表已證明藝術天分或感情經歷。: Placing more weight on your inner life offers one way to understand these stars, but does not establish artistic talent or romantic experience.
sentences.廉貞獨坐寅申，對宮貪狼，會紫相及武府。: Lian Zhen occupies Yin or Shen alone, with Tan Lang in the opposite palace, and meets Zi Wei and Tian Xiang, and Wu Qu and Tian Fu.
sentences.這些星系讓精神與物質的比重有所改變，不能把廉貞單星的感情色彩當成整組答案。: These stars change the relative weight of your inner and material life, so Lian Zhen's emotional qualities alone cannot provide the whole answer.
sentences.借入機梁這一組合，可以從對變化的敏感與對原則的重視開始理解。: When your Life Palace borrows Tian Ji and Tian Liang from the opposite palace, you can begin by considering sensitivity to change and the importance of principles.
sentences.原書要求機梁力量調和，再察同陰、巨陽、輔佐煞化等配合；同時有支持與衝突因素，不代: The book requires the strengths of Tian Ji and Tian Liang to be in harmony, then examines Tian Tong and Tai Yin, Ju Men and Tai Yang, supporting stars, harsh stars and transformations; having both supportive and conflicting factors does not mean they have cancelled each other out.
sentences.原書機梁實坐辰戌，對宮無正曜，三合同陰及借會巨陽。: In the book, Tian Ji and Tian Liang sit in Chen or Xu themselves, with no major star in the opposite palace, Tian Tong and Tai Yin in the linked palaces, and Ju Men and Tai Yang reached through borrowing from the opposite palace.
sentences.你身上剛和柔兩種性情並存，剛柔互相補足時最見成效。: You have both firm and gentle sides, and are most effective when they complement each other.
sentences.你這組命宮的關鍵，是堅定與柔和能否互相配合。: The key to your Life Palace is whether firmness and gentleness can work together.
sentences.果斷不必變成過剛，願意配合也不必失去立場；兩者同在，仍要看怎樣一起發揮。: Being decisive need not become excessive rigidity, and being willing to cooperate need not mean losing your stance; even with both qualities present, how they work together still matters.
sentences.武曲與天相同宮，原書要求剛柔互濟，並提醒過剛、過柔都各有代價。: When Wu Qu and Tian Xiang share a palace, the book calls for firmness and gentleness to support each other, and warns that too much of either has its own cost.
sentences.不能因武曲果斷、天相柔和，就先說兩者已互相補足。: You cannot assume that Wu Qu and Tian Xiang already complement each other simply because one is decisive and the other gentle.
sentences.武曲天相在寅申，對宮破軍，會紫微與廉貞天府。: Wu Qu and Tian Xiang occupy Yin or Shen, with Po Jun in the opposite palace, and meet Zi Wei and Lian Zhen and Tian Fu.
sentences.有輔曜並不自動消除衝突。: Supporting stars do not automatically remove conflict.
sentences.你腦筋轉得快，懂得變通，也會替事情打算。: You think quickly, know how to adapt and plan ahead.
sentences.原書把這組天機列作需要其他星曜扶持的結構，重視得祿、吉化與對宮天梁。: The book treats Tian Ji here as needing support from other stars, placing importance on receiving Abundance, favourable transformations and Tian Liang in the opposite palace.
sentences.它談的不是只靠意志，就能解決所有環境限制。: It does not suggest that willpower alone can overcome every limit imposed by your circumstances.
sentences.你多半要靠自己，身邊的助力較少。: You mostly have to rely on yourself, with less support around you.
sentences.你性情較開朗，內裡那份孤僻能夠化得開。: You have a more cheerful temperament, and your inner reserve can ease.
sentences.空宮借入則另看天同。: If your empty palace borrows these stars from the opposite palace, Tian Tong needs separate consideration.
sentences.你這組命宮把行動的方向放在重點。: Your Life Palace centres on the direction of your actions.
sentences.為了明確目標而改變，與只想擺脫眼前局面而不斷動作，是兩種不同的狀態，不能只看動得: Making changes towards a clear goal and constantly taking action simply to escape your current situation are two different states, so the amount of activity alone is not enough to judge.
sentences.原書用有目標與盲動作比較，並提醒要連福德與三合星系看。: The book compares purposeful action with acting blindly, and reminds you to consider the Wellbeing Palace and the stars in the linked palaces as well.
sentences.太陰獨坐辰戌，對宮太陽，會天機及同梁。: Tai Yin occupies Chen or Xu alone, with Tai Yang in the opposite palace, and meets Tian Ji and Tian Tong and Tian Liang.
sentences.外表不易親近，未必等於有威信；願意獨立行事，也不等於一定孤立。: Seeming unapproachable does not necessarily give you authority or respect; choosing to act independently does not mean you are necessarily isolated.
sentences.原書說孤高與威權在外觀上可能相似，仍要看得祿、輔佐與煞曜怎樣配合。: The book says that aloofness and commanding authority may look similar, so receiving Abundance and the interplay of supporting and harsh stars still need to be considered.
sentences.七殺獨坐寅申，與紫府相對，會貪狼與破軍。: Qi Sha occupies Yin or Shen alone, opposite Zi Wei and Tian Fu, and meets Tan Lang and Po Jun.
sentences.有些配合能減少孤高，仍未足以構成威權。: Some arrangements of stars can reduce aloofness without being enough to establish commanding authority.
sentences.不能把一端減弱，直接當作另一端全部成立。: Weakening one side cannot be taken as proof that the other is fully established.
sentences.火貪的相關收益說法仍有貪狼得祿等前提。: Claims about gains associated with Huo Xing and Tan Lang still depend on conditions such as Tan Lang receiving Abundance.
sentences.借入同梁這一組合，可以由生活情趣與原則紀律怎樣配合開始理解；有兩個面向，不代表它: When your Life Palace borrows Tian Tong and Tian Liang from the opposite palace, you can begin by considering how enjoyment of life works with principles and discipline; having both aspects does not mean they are already in harmony.
sentences.未定也不等於已調和。: Being unsettled does not mean harmony has been reached either.
sentences.你心裡常有感情和理智的拉扯，熟悉的關係和安排，你傾向維持下去。: You often feel a pull between emotion and reason, and tend to maintain familiar relationships and arrangements.
sentences.你這組命宮把感情與理智放在同一個問題裡：想維持的關係、熟悉的安排，與理性上需要作: Your Life Palace brings emotion and reason into the same question: the relationships you want to keep and the arrangements you know may not naturally align with the choices reason calls for.
sentences.重點是兩者能否互相配合。: What matters is whether the two can work together.
sentences.天府與廉貞同宮，不代表理智已經替感情找到答案。: Having Tian Fu and Lian Zhen in the same palace does not mean reason has already found an answer for your feelings.
sentences.原書反而指出，維持既有關係與安於現狀，也可能令原來的矛盾繼續存在。: The book instead points out that maintaining existing relationships and being content with things as they are may also allow the original conflict to continue.
sentences.廉貞天府在辰戌同度，對宮七殺，會紫微及武曲天相。: Lian Zhen and Tian Fu share Chen or Xu, with Qi Sha in the opposite palace, and meet Zi Wei and Wu Qu and Tian Xiang.
sentences.判讀除了本宮感情與理智的關係，亦要看七殺、紫微等星系帶來哪一方向的影響。: Alongside the relationship between emotion and reason in this palace, the reading needs to consider the direction of the influence brought by Qi Sha, Zi Wei and other stars.
sentences.天府得祿或會昌曲，在這個組合中可以加深感情色彩，不能一概當成增加理智。: With these stars, Tian Fu receiving Abundance or meeting Wen Chang and Wen Qu can deepen the emotional element, so neither can always be taken as strengthening reason.
sentences.本節的欲望分類不等於感情事件或行為預測；朝拱與火鈴成格亦有各自配合。: The kinds of desire in this section are not predictions of relationship events or behaviour; patterns built on converging support, or on Huo Xing and Ling Xing, each need their own supporting stars.
sentences.未宮命宮無主星、借丑宮同巨的「明珠出海」，有卯宮太陽及亥宮太陰等會照前提；丑宮借: The ‘Pearl Emerging from the Sea’ (no major star in your Life Palace at Wei, with Tian Tong and Ju Men borrowed from Chou) requires conditions including Tai Yang in Mao and Tai Yin in Hai reaching it; borrowing Tian Tong and Ju Men from Wei into Chou is different.
sentences.紫微貪狼同坐卯酉，會廉貞七殺與武曲破軍。: Zi Wei and Tan Lang share Mao or You, meeting Lian Zhen and Qi Sha, and Wu Qu and Po Jun.
sentences.你這組命宮的主題，是感受與想法向外表達，還是先收在心裡。: The theme of your Life Palace is whether you express your feelings and thoughts outwardly or keep them to yourself at first.
sentences.收斂可以是這組太陰的長處，但收得太緊，亦未必更好。: Restraint can be a strength of Tai Yin here, but holding too much in is not necessarily better.
sentences.原書把外放與收斂看作程度的分別，並連同四化、配曜及出生時段判斷。: The book treats outward expression and restraint as a difference of degree, judging them alongside the four transformations, supporting stars and the time of birth.
sentences.太陰獨坐巳亥，與天機相對，會太陽天梁及借會天同巨門。: Tai Yin occupies Si or Hai alone, opposite Tian Ji, and meets Tai Yang and Tian Liang and, through borrowing from the opposite palace, Tian Tong and Ju Men.
sentences.對宮與三合的配合都會影響表達方式，單看巳亥或一項四化仍不足以概括整體。: The stars in the opposite and linked palaces all affect how you express yourself, so Si or Hai alone, or a single transformation, is still not enough to describe the whole.
sentences.本節同時提醒過度收斂的問題。: This section also warns of the problems of excessive restraint.
sentences.日夜、宮支及不同輔煞也有各自修飾。: Whether you were born by day or night, the palace's branch and the different supporting and harsh stars also each modify the reading.
sentences.你帶浪漫色彩，重生活情趣。: You have a romantic streak and value enjoyment of life.
sentences.你這組命宮把計劃與應變放在重點，也要問想法最終準備服務甚麼目的。: Your Life Palace centres on planning and adapting, while also asking what purpose your ideas are ultimately intended to serve.
sentences.思路靈活是一回事，怎樣使用它，仍有不同方向。: Thinking flexibly is one thing, but you can still put that flexibility to different uses.
sentences.原書以剛柔比較天機的性質，並把福德宮同梁列作關鍵。: The book compares firmness and gentleness in Tian Ji's nature, and identifies Tian Tong and Tian Liang in the Wellbeing Palace as the key.
sentences.天機獨坐子午，對宮巨門，會太陰與同梁。: Tian Ji occupies Zi or Wu alone, with Ju Men in the opposite palace, and meets Tai Yin and Tian Tong and Tian Liang.
sentences.午宮權、忌的沉穩分支，都有火鈴空劫或煞曜多寡的限制。: In Wu, the interpretations of Authority and Obstruction that point to steadiness both have limits involving Huo Xing and Ling Xing, Di Kong and Di Jie, or the number of harsh stars.
sentences.原書把祿權科、伴隨四化與火鈴同度一起看，再察太陽光度，不直接用格名判高低。: The book considers Abundance, Authority and Recognition together with accompanying transformations and Huo Xing and Ling Xing sharing the palace, then examines Tai Yang's brightness, rather than judging strength by a formation's name alone.
sentences.昌曲、桃花、火鈴及吉曜是否同會，都是必要的分別。: Whether Wen Chang and Wen Qu, romance stars, Huo Xing and Ling Xing, and favourable stars meet together are all necessary distinctions.
sentences.天梁本身得祿與會其他化祿也不同。: Tian Liang receiving Abundance itself also differs from meeting other stars turning to Abundance.
sentences.你較容易遭忌，常要先應付是非阻滯。: You are more likely to attract jealousy and often have to deal with disputes and obstacles first.
sentences.紫微化權時，需要再看輔佐及刑煞。: When Zi Wei turns to Authority, supporting stars and stars associated with punishment and harsh effects also need to be considered.
sentences.機巨同坐卯酉，會天同及借會日月。: Tian Ji and Ju Men share Mao or You, meeting Tian Tong and, through borrowing from the opposite palace, Tai Yang and Tai Yin.
sentences.天府化科的相關說法，作者另提出庚干與壬干不同的存疑。: The author also raises a question about the claims concerning Tian Fu turning to Recognition, distinguishing between the Geng and Ren stems.
sentences.你這組命宮把意志與自我約束放在重點。: Your Life Palace centres on willpower and self-restraint.
sentences.值得理解的是，面對吸引或壓力時，能否仍按自己的判斷選擇，並不是表面上看來強硬或柔: What matters is understanding whether you can still choose according to your own judgement when faced with temptation or pressure, rather than whether you appear tough or weak.
sentences.太陰獨坐卯酉，對宮天同，會太陽與天梁。: Tai Yin sits alone in Mao or You, with Tian Tong opposite and Tai Yang and Tian Liang in the linked palaces.
sentences.同樣配曜在不同光度下，不宜直接套同一結論。: The same supporting stars should not automatically lead to the same conclusion when the stars’ brightness differs.
sentences.本機原書節題有太陽／太陰疑字，這裡依正文太陰定位，並不聲稱已校定其他版本。: In our copy of the book, the section heading has a doubtful character (Tai Yang or Tai Yin); this follows the main text in taking it as Tai Yin, without claiming to have checked other editions.
sentences.你兼有開創和守成兩種本事，兩者平衡時可攻可守。: You can both break new ground and preserve what you have built, and when these abilities are balanced, you can push ahead or hold your ground.
sentences.你這組命宮同時有開創與守成的力量。: Your Life Palace gives you strengths in both breaking new ground and preserving what you have built.
sentences.重點不是永遠向前或永遠保守，而是需要前進、需要退守時，能否主動選擇，避免兩邊互相: What matters is not always pushing ahead or always playing safe, but whether you can actively choose to advance or fall back when needed, without letting these two sides hold each other back.
sentences.紫微擅開創，天府擅守成。: Zi Wei excels at breaking new ground, while Tian Fu excels at preserving what has been built.
sentences.紫府在寅申同度，對宮七殺，會武曲及廉貞天相。: Zi Wei and Tian Fu share a palace at Yin or Shen, with Qi Sha in the opposite palace and links to Wu Qu, Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang.
sentences.原書用武曲四化與廉相的配合修訂主動、被動，判讀要看到兩股力量是否真的能配合。: The book refines its assessment of an active or passive outlook through the interplay of Wu Qu’s four transformations with Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang, so the reading needs to consider whether the two forces can really work together.
sentences.原書明說，落陷的太陽若得朝拱或吉化，也可以較積極；入廟而受煞刑忌耗侵擾，則可能轉: The book explicitly says that Tai Yang in a weak position can still bring a more positive outlook if it receives support from surrounding stars or a favourable transformation; at full strength, it may instead bring a negative outlook if disturbed by harsh stars, punishment, Obstruction and depletion.
sentences.申宮的特殊格局有無煞忌刑耗及吉化吉曜等前提；火鈴、空劫又有不同限制。: The special arrangement of stars in Shen has conditions such as an absence of harsh stars, Obstruction, punishment and depletion, and the presence of favourable transformations and favourable stars; Huo Xing and Ling Xing, and Di Kong and Di Jie, have different limits of their own.
sentences.巨門得祿仍可能受到火鈴同度破壞穩重；天機吉化也要保留同時的太陰等四化。: Even when Ju Men receives Abundance, Huo Xing and Ling Xing in the same palace may still undermine steadiness; a favourable transformation of Tian Ji must also be read alongside the simultaneous transformations of Tai Yin and other stars.
sentences.你重原則紀律，做事講章法。: You value principles and discipline, and take an orderly approach to what you do.
sentences.你做事講求實效，容易太看重眼前利益，少作長遠打算。: You focus on practical results and can place too much weight on immediate gains, giving little thought to the longer term.
sentences.你這組命宮值得留意的，是處理眼前利益與人情關係時，兩邊怎樣取捨。: With these stars in your Life Palace, pay attention to how you weigh immediate gains against personal relationships.
sentences.紫相同坐辰戌，對宮破軍，會武曲天府及廉貞。: Zi Wei and Tian Xiang share a palace at Chen or Xu, with Po Jun in the opposite palace and links to Wu Qu, Tian Fu and Lian Zhen.
sentences.你這組命宮值得留意的，是追求成果時的耐力與步伐。: With these stars in your Life Palace, your stamina and pace as you pursue results deserve attention.
sentences.堅持等待時機，與因急於看到結果而不斷加速，會帶來不同的發展方式。: Persisting while you wait for an opportunity and continually speeding up because you are eager for results lead to different ways of progressing.
sentences.原書談機遇，也提醒機遇未到前的躁進可能損傷基礎。: The book discusses opportunities, but also warns that rushing ahead before they arrive may damage your foundations.
sentences.貪狼獨坐辰戌，對宮武曲，會七殺與破軍。: Tan Lang sits alone at Chen or Xu, with Wu Qu in the opposite palace and links to Qi Sha and Po Jun.
sentences.有明確主張，與願意長久做一件事，未必是同一種力量；原書因此要求先分清意志強弱所指: Having clear views and being willing to stay with something for a long time do not necessarily draw on the same strength; the book therefore asks you first to distinguish what kind of will is being described as strong or weak.
sentences.本節有些配合需要少量刺激，有些則怕刺激過重。: Some of the stars discussed together in this section need a little stimulation, while others are vulnerable to too much.
sentences.天同獨坐巳亥，對宮天梁，會機巨及借會日月。: Tian Tong sits alone at Si or Hai, with Tian Liang in the opposite palace, links to Tian Ji and Ju Men, and borrowed links to Tai Yang and Tai Yin from the opposite palace.
sentences.得祿再稍見煞，與化權卻煞刑並見，是不同前提；原文的少量並未轉成自動數量門檻。: Receiving Abundance with a small presence of harsh stars is a different condition from turning to Authority with both harsh stars and punishment present; the original text’s ‘small amount’ does not become an automatic numerical threshold.
sentences.天同化忌需連煞曜與福德配合看。: Tian Tong turning to Obstruction needs to be read alongside the harsh stars and the Wellbeing Palace.
sentences.原書逐組察看光度、吉化與煞曜，分清哪些配合能減少負擔，哪些仍需要太陽解暗或調和。: The book examines brightness, favourable transformations and harsh stars for each group of stars, distinguishing those that can ease the burden from those that still need Tai Yang to dispel darkness or bring balance.
sentences.你是理智型的人，有幕僚的本質。: You are a rational person with a natural aptitude for advising and supporting others.
sentences.武曲、廉貞得祿與破軍得祿，在本節指向不同事情，祿存的位置亦有分別。: In this section, Wu Qu and Lian Zhen receiving Abundance point to different things from Po Jun receiving Abundance, and Lu Cun’s position also differs.
sentences.你這組命宮的主題，是原則怎樣用在自己與別人身上。: The theme of your Life Palace is how you apply principles to yourself and others.
sentences.原書以正直與精明作比較，意思不只在觀察力強弱，也在標準是否同時用於律己律人。: The book compares uprightness with shrewdness, referring not only to how observant you are but also to whether you hold yourself and others to the same standards.
sentences.天梁獨坐丑未，對宮天機，會日月。: Tian Liang sits alone at Chou or Wei, with Tian Ji in the opposite palace and links to Tai Yang and Tai Yin.
sentences.原書較完整的統籌結構，除得祿外仍要求無煞、尤其無空劫；祿存同宮則另帶保守性。: The book’s fuller arrangement for co-ordination requires Abundance as well as an absence of harsh stars, especially Di Kong and Di Jie; Lu Cun in the same palace also brings a conservative tendency.
sentences.天機吉化也要保留同時的太陰等四化。: A favourable transformation of Tian Ji must also be read alongside the simultaneous transformations of Tai Yin and other stars.
sentences.丑宮天府得完整朝拱或本身化科，與未宮反見重煞少吉，都能修訂基本比較。: Tian Fu at Chou receiving full support from surrounding stars or itself turning to Recognition, and Tian Fu at Wei instead facing strong harsh stars with few favourable stars, can both alter the basic comparison.
sentences.真正需要轉向時能行動，和主動推翻現有安排，未必來自同一種力量。: Being able to act when a change of direction is truly needed and taking the initiative to overturn existing arrangements do not necessarily come from the same strength.
sentences.原書先分有目的的應變與缺少目的的破壞，再看四化、輔佐及對宮廉相。: The book first distinguishes purposeful adaptation from destruction without a clear purpose, then considers the four transformations, supporting stars, and Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang in the opposite palace.
sentences.破軍在子午，不應只以「喜歡變動」或格局名稱概括。: Po Jun at Zi or Wu should not be summed up simply as ‘liking change’ or by the name given to the arrangement of stars.
sentences.破軍獨坐子午，對宮廉貞天相，會七殺與貪狼。: Po Jun sits alone at Zi or Wu, with Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang in the opposite palace and links to Qi Sha and Tan Lang.
sentences.你反應靈活，善於隨機應變。: You think on your feet and adapt well as circumstances change.
sentences.子宮化權又是另一方向。: Turning to Authority in the palace at Zi points in another direction.
sentences.原書既看個人的反應，也提醒有些配合會令外在形勢逼人改變。: The book considers your personal responses, while also pointing out that some stars together can leave you facing external circumstances that force you to change.
sentences.武破同坐巳亥，對宮天相，會紫貪與廉殺。: Wu Qu and Po Jun share a palace at Si or Hai, with Tian Xiang in the opposite palace and links to Zi Wei, Tan Lang, Lian Zhen and Qi Sha.
sentences.武曲化忌而無陀羅同度，也有進取的分支。: When Wu Qu turns to Obstruction without Tuo Luo in the same palace, there is also a reading that points towards taking the initiative.
sentences.太陰化忌在這個比較上偏向收斂。: In this comparison, Tai Yin turning to Obstruction leans towards a more restrained outlook.
sentences.在本節的外放／收斂比較中，太陰化忌是偏向收斂的一項訊號。: In this section’s comparison of an outward or restrained outlook, Tai Yin turning to Obstruction is one sign pointing towards restraint.
sentences.你主觀強、有決斷力，也有領導和組織的能力。: You have strong personal views, are decisive, and have the ability to lead and organise.
sentences.你這組命宮的重點，是自己真正喜歡的生活，與物質享受、做事能力之間，怎樣取得平衡。: The focus of your Life Palace is how you balance the life you truly enjoy with material pleasures and your ability to get things done.
sentences.兩者可以互相支持，也可能各有所需。: These two sides can support each other, or they may each have their own needs.
sentences.原書把興趣、好惡與主觀判斷放在精神的一面，把享受、領導與組織放在物質的一面；會合: The book places interests, likes and dislikes, and personal judgement on the side of your inner life, and enjoyment, leadership and organisation on the material side; the stars linked to them change the balance, so Zi Wei alone cannot tell you which side is stronger.
sentences.紫微在子午獨坐，對宮貪狼，會武曲天相及廉貞天府。: Zi Wei sits alone at Zi or Wu, with Tan Lang in the opposite palace and links to Wu Qu, Tian Xiang, Lian Zhen and Tian Fu.
sentences.這幾組星曜對精神與物質的作用不同，骨架要看它們怎樣加強、削弱或轉化彼此。: These groups of stars affect your inner and material life differently, and the underlying structure depends on how they strengthen, weaken or transform one another.
sentences.資料同時出現時，不能把星數相加，就當兩種需要已經平衡。: When these indications appear together, you cannot simply add up the stars and assume that the two needs are balanced.
sentences.空曜或化忌可能減少欲望，但要有吉曜會合才談轉化。: Di Kong, Di Jie or a turn to Obstruction may reduce desire, but favourable stars must be linked to them before this can be called a transformation.
sentences.你的命宮天同化祿，官祿天機同時化權。: Tian Tong in your Life Palace turns to Abundance, while Tian Ji in your Career Palace turns to Authority at the same time.
sentences.天機權成為策動力，讓精神上的寄託有實際投入的支點；你對生活的滿足，可以從做事本身: Tian Ji turning to Authority provides the drive that gives what matters to you inwardly a practical focus for your efforts; you can build satisfaction in life through doing things.
sentences.這份配合重在生活有讓你願意投入的重心，並不等於收入必然豐厚，或每次改變都會順利。: These stars together emphasise having a focus in life that you want to give your time and energy to, without guaranteeing a high income or a smooth outcome from every change.
sentences.你可以留意哪些事情做完之後，會覺得一天過得充實，替它留一段屬於自己的時間。: You can notice which activities leave you feeling that your day has been well spent, and set aside some time of your own for them.
sentences.選擇生活重心時，先看自己願不願意投入，毋須把每項興趣都變成工作或收入。: When choosing your focus in life, first consider whether you want to commit to it, without needing to turn every interest into work or income.
sentences.本盤天同化祿、官祿天機化權，正好具備原文所說的策動支持；命宮的投入與官祿的推動，: Your chart has Tian Tong turning to Abundance and Tian Ji in the Career Palace turning to Authority, providing exactly the support for action described in the original text; your commitment in the Life Palace and the drive in the Career Palace can be understood together.
sentences.申宮的特殊格局有無煞忌刑耗及吉化吉曜等前提。: The special arrangement of stars in Shen has conditions such as an absence of harsh stars, Obstruction, punishment and depletion, and the presence of favourable transformations and favourable stars.
sentences.化祿的豁達說法，要連昌曲及不見桃花等條件。: The claim that turning to Abundance brings an open-hearted outlook must be read alongside conditions such as Wen Chang and Wen Qu being present and romance stars being absent.
sentences.火貪的相關收益說法仍有貪狼得祿等前提；破軍祿若再與羊陀空劫等同會，又有另一限制。: Claims about gains associated with Huo Xing and Tan Lang still depend on conditions such as Tan Lang receiving Abundance; if Po Jun receiving Abundance is also linked to stars such as Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Di Kong and Di Jie, another limit applies.
sentences.你的命宮亦有天馬。: Your Life Palace also contains Tian Ma.
sentences.原書在同梁與天馬的配合中，另提醒理想與實際脫節的傾向。: When discussing Tian Tong and Tian Liang together with Tian Ma, the book also points out a tendency for ideals to lose touch with reality.
sentences.火鈴、空劫又有不同限制。: Huo Xing and Ling Xing, and Di Kong and Di Jie, have different limits of their own.
sentences.原書把天梁四化、祿存配曜與日月光度一起讀；有些看似相反的星曜，只有在特定搭配下才: The book reads Tian Liang’s four transformations, Lu Cun and the supporting stars, and the brightness of Tai Yang and Tai Yin together; some seemingly opposing stars produce different results only when paired in specific ways.
sentences.天同化祿拱照並不直接代表穩定。: Support from Tian Tong turning to Abundance does not directly indicate stability.
sentences.不能只見火貪、鈴貪等名稱，就保證突發或長久順利。: Names such as Huo Xing with Tan Lang or Ling Xing with Tan Lang do not on their own promise a sudden breakthrough or lasting success.
sentences.武曲化權有不受煞曜侵擾的條件。: Wu Qu turning to Authority carries the condition that harsh stars do not disturb it.
sentences.三方火貪的聲勢亦不代替本宮吉化或完整輔佐。: The force of Huo Xing and Tan Lang in the linked palaces also cannot replace a favourable transformation in this palace or a full set of supporting stars.
sentences.原書把天同化忌列為增加感情陰暗面的修飾。: The book treats Tian Tong turning to Obstruction as a modifying factor that increases the darker side of emotional life.
sentences.你性情偏向孤高，與人較有距離。: You tend to be proud and solitary, keeping some distance from others.
sentences.原書把太陽化祿列為支持祥和的一項配合。: The book lists Tai Yang turning to Abundance as one factor supporting peace and harmony.
sentences.原書把廉貞化祿列為加強感情色彩的一項因素。: The book lists Lian Zhen turning to Abundance as one factor that adds emotional colour.
sentences.原書明說，這一項化祿仍不足以選定物質或感情方向，須再合看同會諸曜。: The book explicitly says that this turn to Abundance is still insufficient to establish a material or emotional direction, and must be read alongside all the stars linked to it.
sentences.有些看似相反的星曜，只有在特定搭配下才得到不同結果。: Some seemingly opposing stars produce different results only when paired in specific ways.
sentences.這是武曲過剛一面的修飾。: This modifies the overly rigid side of Wu Qu.
sentences.對你來說，生活裡的情趣與自己認定的原則，容易成為兩股互相牽制的力量。: For you, the pleasures of life and the principles you believe in can easily become two forces that hold each other back.
sentences.想照顧感受時，標準仍放不下；回到標準時，感受又未必能安頓。: When you want to give feelings their due, you still cannot let go of your standards; when you return to those standards, your feelings may remain unsettled.
sentences.遇到去留與取捨，這種來回尤其值得留意。: When deciding whether to stay or leave, or what to keep or let go, this back and forth deserves particular attention.
sentences.你的盤有天同化忌、羊陀相夾的特殊配合，這裡更需要留意兩邊難以兼顧的情況。: Your chart has the special pairing of Tian Tong turning to Obstruction with Qing Yang and Tuo Luo flanking it, making it especially necessary to notice when you struggle to give both sides their due.
sentences.單用重情趣或重紀律其中一面，未能說清這份拉扯。: Describing you only as someone who values life’s pleasures or someone who values discipline does not fully explain this tension.
sentences.你的命宮在申，天同、天梁同宮；天同化忌，又有羊陀相夾。: Your Life Palace is in Shen, with Tian Tong and Tian Liang together; Tian Tong turns to Obstruction, and Qing Yang and Tuo Luo flank the palace.
sentences.原書對這組條件另有說明，涉及情趣與原則之間的徘徊；因此不能只沿用一般偏向，把你歸: The book gives a separate explanation for these conditions, involving wavering between life’s pleasures and principles; you therefore cannot be placed in either category simply by applying the general tendency.
sentences.你有心思也有計劃，比單憑臨場反應踏實得多。: You think things through and make plans, giving you a much firmer footing than relying on reactions in the moment alone.
sentences.巨門得祿仍可能受到火鈴同度破壞穩重。: Even when Ju Men receives Abundance, Huo Xing and Ling Xing in the same palace may still undermine steadiness.
sentences.你擅長機變和計劃，而且為公不為私。: You are good at adapting and planning, and act for the common good rather than personal gain.
sentences.會照的天同化忌，是這張盤要保留的失調因素。: Tian Tong turning to Obstruction in a linked palace is a source of imbalance that must remain part of this chart’s reading.
sentences.按這項條件，可以留意反應過度的傾向。: Given this condition, you can watch for a tendency to overreact.
sentences.你擅長權變，較懂得為自己打算。: You are good at adapting your approach and more adept at looking after your own interests.
sentences.巨門化忌對安定的影響，與吉化對計劃的支持不同。: Ju Men turning to Obstruction affects stability in a different way from the support that favourable transformations give to planning.
sentences.廉貞忌而無煞刑、再有輔佐，與火鈴等同會是不同前提。: Lian Zhen turning to Obstruction with no harsh stars or punishment, and with supporting stars present, is a different condition from having links to stars such as Huo Xing and Ling Xing.
sentences.貪狼化忌時，同時還有破軍化祿的修飾。: When Tan Lang turns to Obstruction, Po Jun turning to Abundance at the same time also modifies the reading.
sentences.原書把巨門化忌列為增加感情陰暗面的因素，這是條件修飾，並不是已發生困擾的證明。: The book lists Ju Men turning to Obstruction as a factor that increases the darker side of emotional life, which modifies the reading under these conditions rather than proving that difficulties have already occurred.
sentences.天同化權時，同時有巨門化忌，須一併保留；離鄉發展亦要求對宮天梁等支持。: When Tian Tong turns to Authority, Ju Men turns to Obstruction at the same time, and both must remain in the reading; building a life away from your home area also requires support from Tian Liang in the opposite palace and other factors.
sentences.原書把貪狼化權列為加強物欲的一項因素，仍要與廉貞及三方星系一起讀。: The book lists Tan Lang turning to Authority as one factor that strengthens material desires, but it must still be read alongside Lian Zhen and the groups of stars in the linked palaces.
sentences.本宮有巨門化祿、祿存。: This palace contains Ju Men turning to Abundance and Lu Cun.
sentences.太陰化祿在這個比較上偏向收斂。: In this comparison, Tai Yin turning to Abundance leans towards restraint.
sentences.午宮權、忌的沉穩分支，都有火鈴空劫或煞曜多寡的限制；子宮化權又是另一方向。: In Wu, the readings of Authority and Obstruction that point to steadiness both have limits involving Huo Xing and Ling Xing, Di Kong and Di Jie, or the number of harsh stars; Authority in Zi points another way.
sentences.單見天馬與同時有祿存又不同。: Tian Ma on its own also differs from Tian Ma together with Lu Cun.
sentences.昌曲同會與單見不同；單見昌曲化忌更有另一方向。: Having both Wen Chang and Wen Qu differs from having only one; a single Wen Chang or Wen Qu turning to Obstruction points another way again.
sentences.原文的少量並未轉成自動數量門檻。: The text's 'a small amount' has not been turned into an automatic numerical threshold.
sentences.紫微化科及輔佐會合另有條件。: Zi Wei turning to Recognition, and supporting stars meeting it, come with conditions of their own.
sentences.火鈴同度又有不同限制。: Huo Xing and Ling Xing in the same palace bring different limits again.
sentences.對宮太陰化忌，尤其連落陷條件，與入廟再會祥瑞，是不同分支。: Tai Yin turning to Obstruction in the opposite palace, especially when it is also weak, is a different branch from Tai Yin at full strength meeting favourable stars.
sentences.卯宮陽梁見昌曲的有利說法，還有不見煞忌等前提；太陽化忌、落陷而再見煞刑虛耗，則是: The favourable reading for Tai Yang and Tian Liang in Mao with Wen Chang and Wen Qu also has preconditions, such as no harsh stars and no Obstruction; Tai Yang turning to Obstruction, weak and meeting harsh stars, punishment and depletion, is a different set of conditions.
sentences.擎羊的作用尤其要分子午：午宮的特殊格局與子宮的限制不同；天同或太陰化忌，又不符合: Qing Yang's effect needs particular care between Zi and Wu: the special formation in Wu differs from the limits in Zi; and Tian Tong or Tai Yin turning to Obstruction does not meet the book's conditions for the 'Sword on the Horse's Head'.
sentences.你遇到刺激和壓力，反而會被激發起來。: Stimulation and pressure tend to spur you on rather than hold you back.
sentences.原書把天府化科列為支持祥和的配合，不同生年仍另有條件。: The book lists Tian Fu turning to Recognition as support for a peaceful temperament, though different birth years carry their own conditions.
sentences.太陽入廟且得祿權的支持，不能直接推成巨門已經理性；巨門化忌時，天同權與天機科也要: Support from Tai Yang at full strength with Abundance and Authority does not by itself make Ju Men rational; when Ju Men turns to Obstruction, Tian Tong with Authority and Tian Ji with Recognition need to be read alongside it.
sentences.武曲化科的平衡說法，仍要求廉相不受火鈴侵擾。: The balanced reading for Wu Qu turning to Recognition still requires Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang to be free of Huo Xing and Ling Xing.
sentences.對宮火鈴的激發，遇武曲忌陀又另有風險，不能把它一律當支持。: The spur from Huo Xing and Ling Xing in the opposite palace carries its own risk when Wu Qu turns to Obstruction with Tuo Luo, so it cannot always be counted as support.
sentences.同梁天馬亦有祿存同度的例外。: Tian Tong and Tian Liang with Tian Ma also have an exception when Lu Cun shares the palace.
sentences.破軍祿若再與羊陀空劫等同會，又有另一限制。: If Po Jun turning to Abundance also meets stars such as Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Di Kong and Di Jie, another limit applies.
sentences.本節把太陰化科列為增加意志力的因素。: This section lists Tai Yin turning to Recognition as a factor that strengthens willpower.
sentences.本命貪狼化忌另有引起躁進的理由。: Tan Lang turning to Obstruction in your birth chart is a separate reason for rushing ahead.
sentences.太陰化忌本身與再被羊陀夾是不同條件。: Tai Yin turning to Obstruction on its own is a different condition from Tai Yin also flanked by Qing Yang and Tuo Luo.
sentences.雄宿乾元的代表條件限未宮，並要求諸吉、昌曲、祿存化祿及無四煞空劫等配合。: The defining conditions of the 'Heroic Star' formation apply only in Wei, and require favourable stars, Wen Chang and Wen Qu, Lu Cun and Abundance, and no Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Huo Xing, Ling Xing, Di Kong or Di Jie.
sentences.本節把天梁化科列為支持融合的一項因素；完整組合仍有祿存與輔佐等前提，未全部成立不: This section lists Tian Liang turning to Recognition as one factor that helps you fit in with others; the full combination also needs Lu Cun and supporting stars, and the full conclusion is not used unless all of them are present.
sentences.天梁化科的完整有利組合，還包括祿存、輔佐與三台八座等條件。: The full favourable combination for Tian Liang turning to Recognition also includes Lu Cun, supporting stars, and San Tai and Ba Zuo.
sentences.本命貪狼化祿另有引起躁進的理由。: Tan Lang turning to Abundance in your birth chart is a separate reason for rushing ahead.
sentences.廉貞化祿的佳格還要求無火鈴會照、昌曲同會。: The favourable formation for Lian Zhen turning to Abundance also requires no Huo Xing or Ling Xing reaching it, and Wen Chang and Wen Qu meeting it together.
sentences.有些配合能減少孤高，仍未足以構成威權；不能把一端減弱，直接當作另一端全部成立。: Some combinations can reduce aloofness without being enough to establish authority; weakening one side cannot be taken as proof that the other is fully in place.
sentences.貪狼、武曲的祿權與化忌，不是同一方向的修飾；資料同時出現時，不能把星數相加，就當: Abundance and Authority on Tan Lang and Wu Qu do not point the same way as Obstruction on them; when these appear together, you cannot add up the stars and assume both needs are balanced.
sentences.你容易表面風光，要防內裡空虛。: You can look successful on the outside, so watch for emptiness inside.
sentences.原書指出武曲化祿可調和其剛克一面。: The book points out that Wu Qu turning to Abundance can soften its hard, cutting side.
sentences.武曲化忌若再受羊陀夾，與火鈴夾武相等情況，要另保留其限制。: When Wu Qu turns to Obstruction and is also flanked by Qing Yang and Tuo Luo, or when Huo Xing and Ling Xing flank Wu Qu and Tian Xiang, those limits must be kept in the reading.
sentences.得祿、武曲化權與輔弼、無吉化而有輔佐等分支，需要連同煞忌及對宮一起看。: Branches such as receiving Abundance, Wu Qu turning to Authority with Zuo Fu and You Bi, or supporting stars without favourable transformations need to be read with the harsh stars, Obstruction and the opposite palace.
sentences.你可以先把手上的時間、零用錢與學習工具安排好，再增加新目標。: Start by organising the time, pocket money and study tools you already have before adding new goals.
sentences.做完一項成果後，留好筆記與方法，讓下一次能接著用。: When you finish a piece of work, keep your notes and methods so you can pick them up next time.
sentences.天同或太陰化忌，又不符合原書所列的馬頭帶劍條件。: Tian Tong or Tai Yin turning to Obstruction also does not meet the book's conditions for the 'Sword on the Horse's Head'.
sentences.原書實坐篇先分情趣與原則，再看會合輔佐煞化及雜曜，另列天同忌與羊陀夾忌的特殊結構: The book's section on these stars sitting in the palace first separates enjoyment from principle, then looks at the supporting stars, harsh stars, transformations and minor stars that meet it, and lists separately the special case of Tian Tong turning to Obstruction flanked by Qing Yang and Tuo Luo.
sentences.破軍祿權與輔佐同會，是原書討論果敢的配合；單見天馬與同時有祿存又不同。: Po Jun with Abundance or Authority meeting supporting stars is the combination the book discusses for boldness; Tian Ma on its own differs from Tian Ma together with Lu Cun.
sentences.原書用因循與進取作比較，卻沒有把吉化全部歸作進取、化忌全部歸作停滯。: The book contrasts sticking to old ways with pushing ahead, but it does not count every favourable transformation as progress or every Obstruction as standing still.
sentences.這是削弱物質一面、使精神一面相對受重視的一項修飾；相對比重不等於物質生活必定不足: This weakens the material side, so your inner life carries relatively more weight; that shift in weight does not mean your material life must fall short.
sentences.你的命宮在申，天同、天梁同宮，天同化忌又有羊陀相夾。: Your Life Palace is in Shen, with Tian Tong and Tian Liang together; Tian Tong turns to Obstruction, and Qing Yang and Tuo Luo flank the palace.
sentences.生活裡想要的情趣，與自己不願放下的標準，容易成為兩股互相牽制的力量；遇到去留與取: The enjoyment you want from life and the standards you won't let go of can easily pull against each other; when you have to decide whether to stay or go, or what to keep, calling yourself either feeling-led or principle-led doesn't capture this back-and-forth.
sentences.財帛太陰要靠計劃累積，又會到命宮天同忌，求財也要投入心力。: Tai Yin in your Wealth Palace builds through planning, and it also meets Tian Tong turning to Obstruction in your Life Palace, so earning money takes real effort.
sentences.懂得安排，與事情做起來是否省力，是兩回事。: Knowing how to arrange things and finding them easy to do are two different matters.
sentences.遇到取捨時，先分清自己想守住的是原則，還是某一種做法。: When you face a choice, first work out whether what you want to protect is a principle or just one way of doing things.
sentences.做法可以調整，也替調整之後的跟進與休息留位置，別把每次多花心力都當作自己做得不夠: Methods can change; leave room for follow-up and rest after each change, and don't treat every extra effort as a sign you fell short.
sentences.你的命宮在申，天同、天梁同宮；天同化忌，前後兩宮分別有陀羅與擎羊。: Your Life Palace is in Shen, with Tian Tong and Tian Liang together; Tian Tong turns to Obstruction, with Tuo Luo and Qing Yang in the palaces on either side.
sentences.這組相夾的條件，在原書中有獨立說明，涉及情趣與原則之間的徘徊。: The book explains this flanking separately, and it concerns wavering between enjoyment and principle.
sentences.即使同宮的火星帶出較重的原則性，仍要保留這組特殊條件所指的拉扯。: Even though Huo Xing in the same palace brings a stronger sense of principle, the tension these special conditions point to still stays in the reading.
sentences.祿存、火星都在你的命宮。: Lu Cun and Huo Xing are both in your Life Palace.
sentences.原書另論同梁天同化忌時，先要求祿存同度或對拱，再分有沒有火鈴空劫同度；你有火星同: When the book discusses Tian Tong and Tian Liang with Tian Tong turning to Obstruction, it first requires Lu Cun in the same or the opposite palace, then separates cases with and without Huo Xing, Ling Xing, Di Kong or Di Jie in the palace; you have Huo Xing there, so the 'without' branch does not apply to you.
sentences.這一支要留意的是發展過程中的變動，與前面情趣和原則之間的拉扯一起理解；它不等於你: What this branch points to is change along the way, read together with the pull between enjoyment and principle above; it does not mean you will necessarily change jobs, and Lu Cun in the palace alone does not make your path steady.
sentences.對宮沒有主星。: The opposite palace has no major star.
sentences.你若在這些方面有反覆不適，可以分開記下部位、開始時間、持續多久，以及對日常有甚麼: If you have recurring discomfort in these areas, make separate notes of where it occurs, when it starts, how long it lasts and how it affects daily life; when you need medical care, clearly describe the changes so healthcare professionals can assess your situation.
sentences.到外地或新環境時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做。: When you travel elsewhere or enter a new environment, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你向手足求助時，可以把需要說得具體：是介紹門路、出時間，還是共同承擔。: When you ask your siblings for help, be specific about what you need: introductions to useful contacts, their time or a share of the responsibility.
sentences.先確認對方能做到哪一部分，再安排自己的下一步，別讓彼此對「幫忙」有不同理解。: First check which part they can manage, then plan your next step, so you both understand what 'help' means.
sentences.安排自己的時間與心情時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往: As you manage your time and emotions, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.和伴侶相處時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做。: In your relationship with your partner, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你帶子女或後輩時，可以先示範一次，再把做法逐步交還對方。: When you guide your children or younger people, demonstrate how to do something once, then gradually let them take over.
sentences.約好目標與完成時間，讓對方自己排流程；需要你幫忙的地方，再一起處理。: Agree on the goal and completion time, and let them organise the steps themselves; work together on any parts where they need your help.
sentences.你和伴侶談不攏時，先說自己在意甚麼，也問對方最想保留甚麼。: If you and your partner cannot agree, first explain what matters to you and ask what they most want to keep.
sentences.一次處理一件事，談好後確認各自下一步怎樣做，別讓原來的小分歧一直疊上舊的不滿。: Deal with one thing at a time, and once you have agreed, confirm what each of you will do next, so a small initial disagreement does not keep adding to old resentments.
sentences.你和父母因住處或生活安排少見面時，可以約定固定聯絡，以及需要幫忙時怎樣找對方。: If your housing or daily arrangements mean you see your parents less often, agree on regular contact and how to reach each other when you need help.
sentences.關心可以落在一件做得到的事上，別只留下「有事再說」。: Show your care through one thing you can actually do, rather than leaving it at 'we'll talk if something comes up'.
sentences.你安排居住或工作基礎時，可以先確認哪些資源真能持續使用、哪些仍受他人安排限制。: When you put the basics in place for your home or work, first check which resources you can genuinely keep using and which are still limited by other people's arrangements.
sentences.把維持費用與自己的承擔談清楚，再逐步增加，讓現有支持先落到日常。: Discuss upkeep costs and your own responsibilities clearly, then build up gradually, putting the support you already have to use in daily life first.
sentences.安排住處或共用空間時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下: As you arrange your home or a shared space, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.活動或運動前後多留意身體反應；有突然出現或明顯加重的不適，就及早求診。: Pay closer attention to how your body responds before and after activity or exercise; seek medical care promptly if discomfort appears suddenly or becomes noticeably worse.
sentences.你在外發展時，可以先建立穩定的落腳安排和幾段可靠的聯絡。: When you establish yourself away from home, first arrange a stable base and a few reliable contacts.
sentences.新機會來到，先看自己能否持續投入，再決定承擔多少。: When a new opportunity comes along, first consider whether you can sustain your involvement, then decide how much to take on.
sentences.你把工作交給別人時，可以同時留下資料、進度與下一步，並約好交接方式。: When you hand work over to someone else, provide the relevant information, an update on progress and the next steps, and agree on how to handle the handover.
sentences.人員或職責有變，就先保住關鍵事情有人接手，讓一時的幫忙留下可延續的方法。: If staff or responsibilities change, first make sure someone takes over the key tasks, so temporary help leaves you with a way of working that can continue.
sentences.你可以為兩人留一段不處理帳單、家務和待辦事項的時間，說說最近真正放在心上的事。: Set aside some time for the two of you without bills, housework or tasks to deal with, and talk about what has really been on your minds lately.
sentences.覺得疏遠時，直接說出想念和需要，別只等對方從日常安排中猜到。: When you feel distant, say directly that you miss them and what you need, rather than just waiting for them to guess from everyday arrangements.
sentences.你和子女或後輩相處有變時，可以重新說清楚彼此現在負責甚麼、希望得到甚麼支持。: If your relationship with your children or younger people changes, clarify again what each of you is now responsible for and what support you hope to receive.
sentences.對方逐漸能自己做，就把相應空間交回去，也保留有困難時可以商量的方式。: As they gradually become able to do things themselves, give them the freedom to handle those things, while keeping communication open so you can discuss any difficulties.
sentences.和朋友、同事合作時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做: When you work with friends or colleagues, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你和父母說話容易各有理解時，可以一次只談一件事，先確認對方聽到的是甚麼。: If you and your parents tend to understand things differently when you talk, discuss just one thing at a time and first check what they have understood.
sentences.自己的需要說具體，也問清楚對方的要求，讓商量有可以做到的下一步。: Be specific about your needs and ask exactly what they are asking for, so your discussion leads to a practical next step.
sentences.和手足或平輩一起做事時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往: As you work with siblings or peers, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你需要長輩支持時，可以先說明真正缺的是資源、方法，還是想有人聽你說。: When you need support from your elders, first explain whether you really need resources, a way to tackle something or someone to listen.
sentences.得到幫忙後，再確認自己可以決定哪些部分，讓照顧回應需要，也保留自己的承擔。: After receiving help, check which parts you can decide for yourself, so the care you receive meets your needs while you retain your own share of responsibility.
sentences.處理工作時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做。: In your work, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.照顧子女或後輩時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做。: When you care for your children or younger people, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你想搬動或改造空間時，可以先列出要改善哪個問題，再確認費用、工序與可用時間。: If you want to move things around or alter a space, first list the problems you want to address, then check the costs, the work involved and the time available.
sentences.先保留日常仍能運作的安排，改完再看是否真的更合用，別讓計劃一直停在想改。: First keep arrangements in place that allow daily life to carry on, then check whether the finished changes really work better for you, so the plan does not remain just a wish to change things.
sentences.和長輩或上司相處時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做: In your dealings with elders or superiors, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你讓有能力的人接手工作時，可以把決定權和責任一起交代。: When you let capable people take over work, set out both their decision-making authority and their responsibilities.
sentences.哪些可自行處理、哪些需共同確認，先講清楚，再按成果與進度跟進，別一面要求獨立、一: First clarify what they can handle themselves and what needs joint agreement, then follow up on results and progress, rather than asking for independence while taking back control of every decision.
sentences.你可以想清楚哪些享受過後真的滿足，哪些只是當下想要更多。: Think through which pleasures leave you truly satisfied afterwards and which you simply want more of in the moment.
sentences.替喜歡的活動留時間和預算，也留一點空白，讓休息不必每次都靠新的安排填滿。: Set aside time and money for activities you enjoy, and leave a little space free too, so rest does not have to be filled with new plans every time.
sentences.你可以和伴侶把相處時間實際排進日程；工作或住處有變，就一起重排。: Put time together with your partner into your diaries; if work or living arrangements change, reschedule it together.
sentences.不能赴約時，主動提出下一次安排，讓對方知道這段關係仍有被放在心上。: If you cannot make an agreed meeting, take the initiative to suggest another time, so your partner knows the relationship still matters to you.
sentences.你選擇或調整空間時，可以先列日常真正需要的功能，再看外觀與規模。: When you choose or adapt a space, first list what you really need it to do in daily life, then consider its appearance and size.
sentences.把使用是否方便、維修是否有人處理、費用能否持續一起確認，讓環境的吸引力有實際用途: Check whether the space is convenient to use, whether someone will handle repairs and whether the costs are sustainable, so its appeal is matched by practical usefulness.
sentences.你接下管理或協調工作前，先確認自己有多少決定權、可調動哪些資源。: Before you take on management or coordination work, first check how much authority you will have and which resources you can draw on.
sentences.比較兩份工作時，把責任與權限一起看；需要上級批覆的部分，也問清楚流程和時間。: When you compare two jobs, consider responsibilities alongside authority; for anything that needs approval from above, also ask about the process and timescale.
sentences.你接下外地或需要往返的安排前，可以把工作、交通、協調和休息時間一起排出來。: Before you commit to arrangements away from home or involving travel back and forth, map out the time needed for work, travel, coordination and rest together.
sentences.新增任務之後，再確認原有責任怎樣交接，讓機會有可以持續的節奏。: After adding new tasks, check again how your existing responsibilities will be handed over, so the opportunity can develop at a pace you can sustain.
sentences.你和伴侶談共同生活時，把金錢分擔和決定方式一起談清楚。: When you and your partner discuss living together, be clear about both how you will share costs and how you will make decisions.
sentences.出得比較多的一方，也要留位置讓另一方參與；自己有需要，就直接提出來。: The person who contributes more also needs to make room for the other to take part; if you need something, ask for it directly.
sentences.你和手足的生活安排有變時，早一點重談分工。: If living arrangements change for you and your siblings, discuss how to divide responsibilities again early on.
sentences.見面少了，可以改用聯絡、預約或文件跟進來互相支持，重點是每一件事仍有人接住。: If you see each other less often, support each other through contact, appointments or written follow-up instead; what matters is that someone still takes care of each task.
sentences.安排自己的時間與心情時，可以約一兩個談得來的人一起做喜歡的事，讓休息不必只靠自己: As you manage your time and emotions, arrange to do something you enjoy with one or two people you find easy to talk to, so you do not have to rely solely on your own efforts to unwind.
sentences.你找人商量時，可以直接說自己需要的是意見、介紹，還是實際協助。: When you turn to someone for a discussion, say directly whether you need advice, an introduction or practical help.
sentences.遇到不同看法，先問清楚理由，再決定採用哪一部分；答應一起做的事另行確認。: If you encounter a different view, first ask about the reasons behind it, then decide which parts to adopt; separately confirm anything you have agreed to do together.
sentences.你和子女或後輩意見不同時，先讓對方把理由說完，再看成果有沒有達到要求。: When you disagree with your children or younger people, first let them finish explaining their reasons, then see whether the results meet the requirements.
sentences.把討論放在事情怎樣做好，也讓對方有機會修正自己的做法。: Keep the discussion focused on how to do the task well, and give them a chance to adjust their approach.
sentences.處理工作時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: At work, take the initiative to discuss things with reliable people and clarify what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.和長輩或上司相處時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投: In your dealings with elders or superiors, if useful support or an opportunity arises, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to commit.
sentences.和朋友、同事合作時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投: When you work with friends or colleagues, if useful support or an opportunity arises, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to commit.
sentences.你進入新團隊時，先問清楚自己的角色、可以決定的事，以及遇到問題找誰。: When you join a new team, first ask about your role, the decisions you can make and whom to go to if problems arise.
sentences.把第一階段要完成的事談具體，讓別人看見你能帶來甚麼。: Discuss exactly what you need to complete in the first stage, so others can see what you can contribute.
sentences.你認識新朋友或合作對象後，可以先從一件範圍清楚的小事開始。: After you meet new friends or people you might work with, start with one small task with a clearly defined scope.
sentences.看彼此是否守時、能交代、願意溝通，再逐步加深合作。: See whether you both keep to agreed times, give clear updates and are willing to communicate, then gradually work more closely together.
sentences.身體不適時，可以請家人或朋友陪同求診，一起記下醫護的建議。: When you feel unwell, ask a family member or friend to accompany you when you seek medical care, and note down the healthcare professionals' advice together.
sentences.和手足或平輩一起做事時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: As you work with siblings or peers, take the initiative to discuss things with reliable people and clarify what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.你可以在忙碌之間留一段沒有交付要求的時間，做一件自己喜歡的小事。: Set aside a stretch of time in your busy schedule with nothing you have to produce, and do one small thing you enjoy.
sentences.暫停時把下一步記好，讓自己不用一邊休息、一邊掛念還有甚麼未完成。: When you pause, write down your next step so you do not have to worry about unfinished tasks while you rest.
sentences.安排住處或共用空間時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: When you arrange your home or a shared space, take the initiative to discuss things with reliable people and clarify what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.你和別人共用住處、空間或設備時，可以先談誰能使用、誰作決定、誰負責維護，以及費用: If you share a home, space or equipment with others, first discuss who can use it, who makes decisions, who handles upkeep and how to divide the costs.
sentences.重要安排留共同紀錄，有變動一起確認，讓資源在手之後仍用得安穩。: Keep a shared record of important arrangements and confirm any changes together, so you can continue using the resources with peace of mind once you have them.
sentences.和朋友、同事合作時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: In your work with friends or colleagues, take the initiative to discuss things with reliable people and clarify what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.安排自己的時間與心情時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決: As you manage your time and emotions, if useful support or an opportunity arises, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to commit.
sentences.照顧子女或後輩時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投入: When you care for your children or younger people, if useful support or an opportunity arises, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to commit.
sentences.和伴侶相處時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投入多少: In your relationship with your partner, if useful support or an opportunity arises, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to commit.
sentences.處理工作時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投入多少。: At work, if useful support or an opportunity arises, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to commit.
sentences.和長輩或上司相處時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: In your dealings with elders or superiors, take the initiative to discuss things with reliable people and clarify what each of you is responsible for.
