sentences.你需要轉換住處或使用安排時，可以先確認新安排何時能接上，再處理舊安排的退出與交接: When you need to change where you live or how you use a place, first confirm when the new arrangements will be ready, then arrange to end the old ones and complete any handover.
sentences.把過渡期間的費用、物品和日常需要列清楚，避免改了地方卻暫時失去可用基礎。: List the costs, belongings and daily needs involved in the transition clearly, so moving does not leave you temporarily without the basics you need.
sentences.你比較兩份工作時，可以問清楚每天真正要操作、檢查或交付甚麼，再看工具、流程與支援: When you compare two jobs, ask exactly what you would need to operate, check or deliver each day, then assess whether the tools, processes and support are adequate.
sentences.把擅長的實作能力留成可展示的成果，也確認出問題時由誰協助處理。: Keep examples of work that show your practical strengths, and confirm who will help resolve problems if they arise.
sentences.破軍見空劫，原書用「有緣無情」形容這項配合。: When Po Jun meets Di Kong and Di Jie, the book describes these stars as bringing 'a bond without affection'.
sentences.兩個人可以仍有共同生活、共同責任，感情上的連結卻需要另外經營；關係維持與心意相通: You may still share a life and responsibilities, while your emotional connection needs separate care; maintaining the relationship and understanding each other's feelings are two distinct strands here.
sentences.你需要親友幫忙時，可以先找出事情缺的是哪一種能力，再請對方承擔適合的一部分。: When you need help from relatives or friends, first identify which skill the task is missing, then ask the other person to take on a suitable part.
sentences.彼此的專長接得上，還要約好交付時間與誰負責整合。: Even when your skills fit together, agree when each part will be delivered and who will bring everything together.
sentences.和朋友、同事合作時，需要你拿主意的事，先分清哪些自己能決定、哪些要與人商量，讓主: When you work with friends or colleagues and a decision falls to you, first be clear about what you can decide yourself and what needs discussion with others, so taking the lead does not mean carrying everything alone.
sentences.要留意你是否能在日常保留自己的空間，以及安靜之後是否更清楚。: Notice whether you can keep some space for yourself in daily life, and whether quiet time leaves you clearer about things.
sentences.到外地或新環境時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚的: When you travel elsewhere or enter a new environment, organise your methods, records and other people's views, so you have a clear basis for explaining things when needed.
sentences.正文的取象涉及筋骨與疼痛、皮膚。: The main text draws symbolic links with muscles and bones, pain and skin.
sentences.破軍獨坐，原書明說合作偏向開創，不偏向收成。: When Po Jun is alone in this palace, the book explicitly says that cooperation tends towards starting something new rather than reaping the rewards.
sentences.要留意彼此是否適合打開局面，也看成果出現之後能否繼續分工。: Consider whether you are suited to getting things started together, and whether you can continue sharing the work once results appear.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，七殺的傳統疾厄取象，先談呼吸，再談跌打與傷痛。: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional approach to health readings, Qi Sha's traditional symbolic associations concern breathing first, followed by injuries from falls or blows and pain.
sentences.原書明言，逐曜對應的說法以單見一曜為準；再兼見其他煞曜，便須另作整體理解。: The book explicitly states that its individual star associations apply when only one harsh star is present; if other harsh stars are also present, the combination must be considered as a whole.
sentences.天相獨坐，原書重視副手、服務與體系內的責任。: When Tian Xiang is alone in this palace, the book emphasises supporting roles, service and responsibilities within an organisation.
sentences.關鍵在於你是否能獨立完成一塊工作，以及名義位置有沒有反映實際權限。: What matters is whether you can complete a defined part of the work independently, and whether your formal position reflects your actual authority.
sentences.安排自己的時間與心情時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有: As you manage your time and emotional needs, organise your methods, records and other people's views, so you have a clear basis for explaining things when needed.
sentences.你若有反覆的腹脹或腸胃不適，可以記下何時出現、吃過甚麼，以及排便有沒有改變。: If you have recurring bloating or stomach or bowel discomfort, note when it happens, what you have eaten and whether your bowel habits have changed.
sentences.症狀反覆或持續時，帶著這些紀錄求診，讓醫護掌握實際情況。: If the symptoms recur or persist, take these records to a medical appointment so the healthcare professional can understand what has been happening.
sentences.處理工作時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚的依據交: At work, organise your methods, records and other people's views, so you have a clear basis for explaining things when needed.
sentences.巨門獨坐，原書吉的一面是舌辯與共同討論創興，凶的一面才是口舌爭吵。: When Ju Men is alone in this palace, the book describes its favourable side as persuasive speech and building something new through joint discussion, while verbal disputes belong to its unfavourable side.
sentences.關鍵在於意見交流有沒有讓工作更清楚。: What matters is whether exchanging views makes the work clearer.
sentences.要緊的是對方如何獨立，也看你們能否保留交流。: What matters is how the other person becomes independent, and whether you can keep communicating.
sentences.晚輩開始有自己的安排，關係便需要新的交流方式；是否仍願意商量，比是否一直跟隨原來: As younger people begin making their own plans, your relationship needs new ways to communicate; pay more attention to whether they are still willing to discuss things than whether they keep following the old approach.
sentences.七殺獨坐，原書明說輔佐可以增加人數，卻不因此增加助力；得祿又是另一層支持。: When Qi Sha is alone in this palace, the book explicitly says that supporting stars can increase the number of people without thereby increasing the help you receive; receiving Abundance adds another layer of support.
sentences.關鍵在於工作能否真正被分擔，而不只看人手。: What matters is whether the work can actually be shared, beyond the number of people available.
sentences.關鍵在於關係如何延續，以及對方的資源能否實際幫你。: What matters is how the relationship continues, and whether the other person's resources can help you in practice.
sentences.和手足或平輩一起做事時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有: When you work with siblings or peers, organise your methods, records and other people's views, so you have a clear basis for explaining things when needed.
sentences.你答應幫手或接受支援時，可以把範圍與期限先說清楚。: Before you agree to help or accept support, be clear about its scope and time limit.
sentences.後來增加的要求另行商量，別因為交情深，就把所有責任默默接下來。: Discuss any later requests separately, rather than quietly taking on every responsibility because you are close.
sentences.你和伙伴開新項目時，先談好開展之後由誰繼續跟進。: When you start a new project with a partner, first agree who will keep following it through once it is under way.
sentences.對方適合幫你打開局面，就另留一份維持與交接的安排，讓成果出現後仍有人接住。: If the other person is well suited to helping you get things started, make a separate plan for ongoing work and handover, so someone can carry things forward once results appear.
sentences.七殺獨坐，原書特別區分一般下屬可以多，而親近培育的弟子卻少。: When Qi Sha is alone in this palace, the book specifically distinguishes between the many staff you may have and the few pupils you mentor closely.
sentences.關鍵在於你真正投入教導的是哪些人，不用人數代替關係深度。: What matters is whom you truly invest time and effort in teaching, without treating numbers as a measure of how deep the relationships are.
sentences.可以回看對方是否有機會自行完成一項工作。: Look back at whether the other person has had the chance to complete a task on their own.
sentences.要留意有人歡迎你之外，是否也願意共同承擔。: Notice whether people who welcome you are also willing to share responsibility.
sentences.破軍獨坐，原書有疏離與主管更換的主題，亦明列輔佐對星可以調和。: With Po Jun alone in this palace, the book discusses distance in relationships and changes of manager, and explicitly states that paired supporting stars can ease these difficulties.
sentences.要留意工作或生活變動之後，是否仍有清楚的交流方式。: Notice whether you still have clear ways to communicate after changes in work or daily life.
sentences.破軍得輔佐，創見與新做法的主題更突出。: When Po Jun has supporting stars, original ideas and new ways of doing things become more prominent.
sentences.本盤左右兩曜齊見，想法怎樣從構想到實行，是這份精神活動的一部分。: Your birth chart contains both Zuo Fu and You Bi, and working out how to put ideas into practice is part of this mental activity.
sentences.破軍獨坐，原書在子午談親近晚輩的代溝。: With Po Jun alone in this palace at Zi or Wu, the book discusses a generation gap with younger people close to you.
sentences.有責任感，也仍需要安排交流；工作、住處或其他要求有變時，兩人的相處方式就需要一起: Even with a sense of responsibility, you still need to make time to communicate; when work, living arrangements or other demands change, you both need to adjust how you relate to each other.
sentences.天梁獨坐，原書偏重遵循原則、查核與向人交代的工作。: With Tian Liang alone in this palace, the book emphasises work that involves following principles, checking details and being accountable to others.
sentences.要留意你是替事情把關，還是負責調動人手執行；兩者並不相同。: Notice whether you are responsible for checking that things meet requirements or for organising people to carry them out; these are different roles.
sentences.求診時可以帶上過往的紀錄與檢查結果，方便醫護前後比較。: Bring previous records and test results to medical appointments so that healthcare staff can compare them over time.
sentences.正文的取象涉及水道與排泄、皮膚。: The main text's symbolic associations involve the body's fluid passages, excretion and skin.
sentences.對方建立自己的方向，不必等於不珍惜你的教導。: The other person finding their own direction need not mean they do not value your guidance.
sentences.要緊的是交情如何表達，不能只由見面多不多判斷助力。: What matters is how friendship is expressed; how often you meet cannot by itself tell you how much support you have.
sentences.意見難聽與意見沒有用，是兩回事。: Advice that is hard to hear and advice that is unhelpful are two different things.
sentences.可以回看對方提醒之後是否願意陪你處理事情。: Look back at whether the other person was willing to help you deal with things after offering a reminder.
sentences.要緊的是環境是否真的讓你接上資源。: What matters is whether your surroundings actually give you access to resources.
sentences.太陰這裡重在人際接觸之後，支援怎樣真正到位。: Tai Yin here emphasises how support actually reaches you after you make contact with people.
sentences.新環境的吸引力要連這些實際安排一起理解。: Assess the appeal of a new environment alongside these practical arrangements.
sentences.要留意你是否常需要把資訊說清楚、回應質疑或協調不同立場。: Notice whether you often need to explain information clearly, respond to challenges or reconcile different positions.
sentences.天府獨坐，原書的現成基礎可以是一家已有規模的企業，不必是父祖產業。: With Tian Fu alone in this palace, the existing foundation described in the book can be an established business of some size and need not be property or a business inherited from your father or earlier generations.
sentences.關鍵在於你能接手甚麼，以及有沒有權限與資源改善它。: What matters is what you can take over, and whether you have the authority and resources to improve it.
sentences.天府的工作基礎，要看你實際能接手多少、能改善多少。: The foundation for your work associated with Tian Fu depends on how much you can actually take over and improve.
sentences.已有制度與資源可以承接，也可能附帶決定上的限制；穩定的平台與能否發揮，需要一起衡: You may have established systems and resources to take over, but these may also come with limits on your decisions; weigh the stability they offer alongside the scope to use your abilities.
sentences.要留意社交之後，有多少人願意參與真正需要承擔的事情，而不是以認識人多判定支持充足: After socialising, notice how many people are willing to take part when real responsibility is involved, rather than assuming you have enough support because you know many people.
sentences.可以區分一起消遣、介紹機會與共同負責。: Distinguish between spending leisure time together, introducing opportunities and sharing responsibility.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，破軍在傳統疾厄論中化耗，書中從消耗性取象談起，也談牙齒、筋: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of the Health Palace, Po Jun signifies depletion; the book begins with symbolic associations of depletion and also discusses teeth, tendons and bones, skin and injuries.
sentences.同度主星、四化與配曜，使各條主線有所轉移。: Major stars sharing this palace, the four transformations and supporting stars shift the emphasis of each main theme.
sentences.原書坦言，某些配合的齒與骨之應有時難以分辨。: The book openly acknowledges that, with certain stars together, it is sometimes difficult to distinguish whether the indications concern teeth or bones.
sentences.原書也用此宮參照機構內的支持與掣肘。: The book also uses this palace to assess support and constraints within an organisation.
sentences.先看對方想怎樣發展，以及兩代或師生能否理解彼此的目標。: First consider how the other person wants to develop, and whether the two generations, or teacher and student, can understand each other's goals.
sentences.有分歧未必代表缺乏感情。: Disagreements do not necessarily mean a lack of affection.
sentences.關鍵在於對方實際提供甚麼，再看自己的需要有沒有被理解。: What matters is what the other person actually provides, followed by whether your own needs are understood.
sentences.對照時，要留意看需要共同承擔的事情，有沒有實際資源與分工。: When comparing these points, check whether there are practical resources and a division of tasks for matters that require shared responsibility.
sentences.天相獨坐，原書特別要求看對宮與相鄰星曜。: With Tian Xiang alone in this palace, the book specifically calls for examining the opposite palace and the stars in the neighbouring palaces.
sentences.要留意你替事情負責時，是否也有形成自己主張的空間，而不是只回應別人的要求。: When you take responsibility for something, notice whether you also have room to develop your own position, rather than only responding to other people's demands.
sentences.回應別人的要求之餘，是否也知道自己願意投入甚麼，會影響事情做好後能留下多少滿足。: Alongside responding to other people's demands, knowing what you are willing to put your time and effort into affects how much satisfaction remains once the work is done well.
sentences.關鍵在於提醒是否有助事情，也看提出後能否共同完成。: What matters is whether a reminder helps with the task, and whether you can then complete it together.
sentences.天同獨坐，原書明說精神生活可以豐足，未必代表物質充裕。: With Tian Tong alone in this palace, the book explicitly states that you may have a rich inner life without necessarily having material plenty.
sentences.要留意你真正享受甚麼，以及是否能在日常保留這些小事。: Notice what you truly enjoy, and whether you can keep these small pleasures in your daily life.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，太陽的傳統疾厄取象，以陽明之火與眼目為主線，也延伸到頭部、: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of the Health Palace, Tai Yang's symbolic associations centre on Yangming fire and the eyes, and also extend to the head, breathing and large intestine.
sentences.正文的取象涉及消化與腸胃、呼吸、眼目。: The main text's symbolic associations involve digestion, the stomach and intestines, breathing and the eyes.
sentences.要留意機會背後有沒有持續的支持。: Notice whether opportunities come with ongoing support.
sentences.梁祿又按宮支有不同是非修飾。: With Tian Liang turning to Abundance, the indications of disputes also vary according to the palace's branch.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，巨門的傳統疾厄取象，一面屬陰土，談消化；一面屬陰金，談呼吸: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of the Health Palace, Ju Men's symbolic associations relate both to yin earth, concerning digestion, and to yin metal, concerning breathing.
sentences.煞曜、刑曜與虛耗雜曜，決定接著讀哪一項配合。: Harsh stars, stars associated with punishment, and minor stars associated with emptiness and depletion determine which set of stars to examine next.
sentences.安排住處或共用空間時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清: When you arrange your home or a shared space, organise your methods, records and other people's views so that you have a clear basis for explaining your decisions when needed.
sentences.你若有反覆出現的不適，可以記下部位、開始時間、持續多久，以及對日常有甚麼影響。: If you have recurring discomfort, note where it occurs, when it starts, how long it lasts and how it affects daily life.
sentences.需要求診時，把實際變化說清楚，讓醫護按你的情況評估。: When you need medical advice, explain the actual changes clearly so that healthcare staff can assess your circumstances.
sentences.太陽、太陰同宮，原書即使見吉也保留忙碌與變動不居的主題。: With Tai Yang and Tai Yin together in this palace, the book retains the themes of busyness and continual change even when favourable stars are present.
sentences.要留意你的活動範圍怎樣擴大，同時留意生活安排能否承接。: Notice how your range of activities expands, and whether your daily arrangements can accommodate it.
sentences.關鍵在於思考是否讓你更清楚，還是不斷改變已作的決定。: What matters is whether thinking things through brings you greater clarity or keeps you changing decisions you have already made.
sentences.留意哪些問題已有足夠資訊，哪些還需要新的事實。: Notice which questions you already have enough information to answer, and which still need new facts.
sentences.天同獨坐，原書重視相處的感情與溝通。: With Tian Tong alone in this palace, the book emphasises affection and communication in your relationships.
sentences.照顧子女或後輩時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚的: When you care for children or younger people, organise your methods, records and other people's views so that you have a clear basis for explaining your decisions when needed.
sentences.關係隨工作或環境改變，不必直接理解成感情不好；需要留意的是改變後彼此還能提供甚麼: A relationship changing with work or circumstances need not be taken as a sign of a weak emotional bond; notice what you can still offer each other after the change.
sentences.留意某段關係最容易在哪個階段疏遠：是見面減少，還是責任和期待改變。: Notice when a particular relationship is most likely to grow distant: when you meet less often, or when responsibilities and expectations change.
sentences.部分子午分支亦提醒不要過度出頭。: Some of the cases at Zi and Wu also advise you against putting yourself forward too much.
sentences.要留意怎樣把原則轉成有用的支持。: Notice how you turn principles into useful support.
sentences.教導時可以讓對方說出判斷依據，再討論需要承擔甚麼。: When you teach someone, let them explain the basis for their judgement, then discuss what responsibilities they need to take on.
sentences.要留意你怎樣回應不同需求，以及改變之後如何持續完成工作。: Notice how you respond to different needs, and how you continue to get work done after changes.
sentences.工作、應酬或其他責任佔用多少空間，需要放回實際生活理解。: Consider how much room work, social obligations or other responsibilities take up in the context of your actual daily life.
sentences.和伴侶相處時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚的依據: In your relationship with your partner, organise your methods, records and other people's views so that you have a clear basis for explaining your decisions when needed.
sentences.這組要留意兩個人是否有共同方向，以及合作時由誰主導；一起向前發展，仍要讓彼此在關: With these stars, notice whether you share a direction and who takes the lead when you work together; as you move forwards together, you still need to make room for each other in the relationship.
sentences.原書談紫貪見吉可以合作創業時，仍要求以配偶為事業主體。: When the book says that Zi Wei and Tan Lang with favourable stars can indicate starting a business together, it still requires your spouse to be the main person in the business.
sentences.共同做事並不是每人都各自作主；是否合作，仍要另外談清楚角色與責任。: Working together does not mean each person makes decisions independently; in deciding whether to work together, you still need a separate discussion to clarify roles and responsibilities.
sentences.可以先看兩人如何交流需要，避免把保護、代辦與真正讓對方成長混成同一件事。: First look at how you communicate your needs to each other, so that you do not confuse protecting someone, doing things for them and truly allowing them to grow.
sentences.保護可以讓對方安心嘗試，代辦卻可能讓成長的機會一直留在自己手上。: Protecting the other person can help them feel safe enough to try, but doing things for them may keep the opportunities for growth in your own hands.
sentences.機陰這裡要分清何時需要照顧、何時可以交回對方決定。: With Tian Ji and Tai Yin here, distinguish between when care is needed and when you can hand decisions back to the other person.
sentences.紫微、貪狼同宮，原書偏重消費、享受與社交形成的事業，也提醒號召力與組織力不同。: With Zi Wei and Tan Lang together in this palace, the book emphasises careers built around spending, enjoyment and socialising, and also reminds you that attracting people and organising them are different abilities.
sentences.關鍵在於吸引人之後，事情能否持續運作。: What matters is whether things can keep running after you have attracted people.
sentences.天機、太陰同宮，原書以遷動與工作環境變換作重要主題。: With Tian Ji and Tai Yin together in this palace, the book treats moves and changes of working environment as important themes.
sentences.可以先分清改變的是居住安排、資源使用，還是工作的基礎，不由一種變動概括全部。: First distinguish whether the change concerns your living arrangements, your use of resources or the foundation of your work, without treating one kind of change as covering them all.
sentences.要留意的是談事時能否互相理解，以及意見之後有沒有實際支持。: Notice whether you understand each other when discussing matters, and whether advice is followed by practical support.
sentences.能給意見的人，未必能替你承擔；常有辯論，也未必毫無助力。: Someone who can offer advice may not be able to shoulder responsibilities for you; frequent debate does not necessarily mean there is no support.
sentences.關鍵在於實際起點，不能把白手解成你必定沒有家庭支持。: What matters is your actual starting point; starting from scratch cannot be taken to mean that you definitely have no family support.
sentences.留意工作是否與志趣相合，以及哪些能力能逐步累積，未由天同就保證安逸或藝術成就。: Notice whether your work fits your interests and aspirations, and which abilities you can build over time; Tian Tong alone does not promise an easy life or artistic achievement.
sentences.可以先看換環境後是否更容易生活與工作，而不只看收入。: First consider whether a change of environment makes daily life and work easier, rather than looking only at income.

sentences.原書的有利與加重分支仍受四化、吉煞及日夜修飾。: The book's more favourable and more difficult cases are still modified by the four transformations, favourable and harsh stars, and whether you were born by day or at night.

sentences.天機、巨門同宮，原書保留勞心的提醒。: With Tian Ji and Ju Men together in this palace, the book retains its caution about mental strain.
sentences.你有反覆痛楚時，可以記下位置、持續時間，以及哪些動作會令感受改變。: If you have recurring pain, note where it occurs, how long it lasts and which movements change how it feels.

sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，天機、太陰同度，原書用腎水養肝木解釋這組疾厄取象，並談到思: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of the Health Palace, when Tian Ji and Tai Yin share this palace, the book explains their symbolic health associations through the idea of kidney water nourishing liver wood, and also discusses signs of worry and weakness.
sentences.太陰的廟陷，是這裡一項重要分別。: Whether Tai Yin is well or poorly placed is an important distinction here.

sentences.要留意投入興趣之後是否得到樂趣，還是很快又需要下一個目標。: Notice whether pursuing an interest brings you enjoyment, or whether you soon need another goal.
sentences.這組要分清享受一件事，與急著追下一個目標。: With these stars, distinguish between enjoying something and rushing to pursue the next goal.
sentences.得到想要的東西之後，是否願意停留、品味，還是很快又轉向下一項，會影響日常能留下多: Once you get what you want, whether you are willing to pause and savour it or quickly turn to the next thing affects how much lasting satisfaction you find in daily life.
sentences.可以先看客觀距離，再看交流與支持是否仍然存在。: First consider the physical distance, then whether communication and support are still present.
sentences.要留意支持是否讓你更能獨立完成事情。: Notice whether support makes you more able to complete things independently.
sentences.兩星皆落陷與一般同度，是不同的一支。: Both stars being poorly placed is a separate case from simply sharing a palace.
sentences.關鍵在於接觸面與工作支援是否同步。: What matters is whether support for your work keeps pace with the range of people you meet.
sentences.人多、願意回應與真正能補位各自不同。: Having many people around, having people willing to respond and having people who can actually step in are different things.
sentences.住得舒服，還需要有能持續使用的安排。: Living comfortably also requires arrangements you can keep using.
sentences.煞忌的加重亦不轉成對朋友品格的定罪。: Even when harsh stars and Obstruction make the indications more difficult, this does not amount to a judgement against your friends' character.
sentences.太陽獨坐，原書不論廟陷都帶活動性，另看日夜、輔佐與煞曜。: With Tai Yang alone in this palace, the book associates it with activity whether it is well or poorly placed, and separately considers birth by day or at night, supporting stars and harsh stars.
sentences.要留意投入他人與事情之後，是否也保留自己的空間。: Notice whether you keep some space for yourself after giving time and energy to other people and activities.
sentences.忙碌可以有價值，也可能只是停不下來。: Being busy can be worthwhile, but it may also simply mean you cannot stop.

sentences.要緊的是氣氛好之外，工作有沒有真的被接手。: Beyond a pleasant atmosphere, what matters is whether someone actually takes on the work.
sentences.你比較兩份工作時，可以把日常要兼顧的範圍問清楚，再看時間與支援夠不夠。: When you compare two jobs, ask exactly what you would need to manage day to day, then check whether you would have enough time and support.

sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，天梁的傳統疾厄取象，主線涉及脾胃與鼻部；書中也談一般配合下: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional health readings, Tian Liang is mainly associated with the spleen, stomach and nose; the book also describes fewer or milder health problems, or a return to stability after a health crisis, with the usual accompanying stars.
sentences.煞忌與其他配曜加入後，則另有不同走向。: When harsh stars, Obstruction and other supporting stars are present, the reading takes different directions.
sentences.天梁的化解性質，與這些條件是連在一起的。: Tian Liang's ability to ease difficulties is tied to these conditions.
sentences.天同獨坐，原書多談交友面與助力不相等。: With Tian Tong alone in this palace, the book often explains that the breadth of your friendships does not equal the support you receive.
sentences.先看彼此願不願往來，再看需要處理事情時，誰能真正分擔。: First consider whether you both want to stay in touch, then who can genuinely share the load when something needs doing.
sentences.平日容易相處，未必代表合作自然順利。: Getting on easily day to day does not necessarily mean you will work smoothly together.

sentences.見面少了仍可能有照顧，常在身邊也仍可能有誤解；需要看清的是安排有甚麼變化，以及彼: You may still receive care when you meet less often, and misunderstandings may remain even with someone regularly beside you; what needs clarifying is how the arrangements have changed and whether you have both expressed what you really need.
sentences.太陽田宅也可參照工作機構的變換。: Tai Yang in your Property Palace can also be read in relation to changes in the organisation you work for.
sentences.住處、產業與服務機構是不同範圍，各自要看可用資源、維持安排與轉換成本；一邊有變動: Your home, property assets and the organisation you work for are separate areas, each requiring a look at available resources, arrangements for keeping things going and the cost of change; a change in one does not automatically mean the same in another.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，天機在傳統疾厄論中屬木，主線涉及肝、四肢與思慮。: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional health readings, Tian Ji belongs to the wood element and is mainly associated with the liver, limbs and mental activity.

sentences.可以先看相處是否願意交流，再看事情怎樣分擔。: First consider whether you are both willing to communicate when you spend time together, then how you share what needs doing.

sentences.發現理解不同就當時談清楚，重要變動留下共同紀錄。: If you find that you understand things differently, clarify them there and then, and keep a shared record of important changes.
sentences.太陰獨坐，原書按日夜、廟陷另論助力。: With Tai Yin alone in this palace, the book assesses support differently according to whether you were born by day or night and whether the star occupies a strong or weak position.
sentences.可以回看事情是資訊不足、安排失誤，還是責任未說清楚。: Look back at whether the issue was missing information, a mistake in the arrangements or responsibilities that were not made clear.

sentences.生活與環境改變時，除了重新安排事情，也要讓彼此知道感受有沒有跟著改變。: When your life and surroundings change, rearrange practical matters and let each other know whether your feelings have changed too.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，天同、天梁的疾厄取象，原書先談下部，即排泄與生殖系統，再談: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional health readings of Tian Tong and Tian Liang, the book first discusses the lower body, meaning the excretory and reproductive systems, then descriptions such as pain attributed to liver qi or heart qi.
sentences.同梁既有一般取象，也有刑煞忌與多項雜曜並見的情況；天梁的一面，要放回天同及配曜的: Tian Tong and Tian Liang have their general associations, as well as readings involving stars associated with punishment, harsh stars, Obstruction and several minor stars together; Tian Liang's role needs to be understood in the context of its relationship with Tian Tong and all the accompanying stars.
sentences.要留意吸引人之後怎樣持續交付。: Consider how you will keep delivering once you have attracted people's interest.
sentences.展示、設計或交際可以打開接觸面，後面仍需要組織、成本與跟進；外觀看來有規模，不能: Presentation, design or socialising can broaden your contacts, but organisation, costs and follow-up still need attention; looking substantial from the outside cannot replace support within.
sentences.要留意彼此是否因工作安排而少聚，以及支持是否仍能延續。: Notice whether work arrangements mean you spend less time together, and whether support can still continue.
sentences.少聚未必就是感情不足，亦不能據此補寫父母婚史。: Spending less time together does not necessarily mean a weaker emotional bond, nor does it justify filling in details of your parents' marital history.
sentences.天機獨坐，原書重視兩代距離與變動，也以祿權科作穩定的支持。: With Tian Ji alone in this palace, the book emphasises distance and changes between the generations, and treats Abundance, Authority and Recognition as support for stability.
sentences.要留意見面、照顧或工作安排改變時，彼此能否重新交代期待。: When arrangements for meeting, care or work change, check whether you can both explain your expectations afresh.
sentences.重點在於培育關係如何延續。: The focus is on how you sustain a relationship that helps someone grow.
sentences.破軍獨坐，原書要求輔佐與祿等支持，並按子午、寅申、辰戌的對宮另分。: With Po Jun alone in this palace, the book requires support from supporting stars, Abundance and similar factors, and makes further distinctions according to the opposite palace at Zi or Wu, Yin or Shen, and Chen or Xu.
sentences.要留意交接、分工與持續合作有甚麼實際基礎。: Look at the practical basis for handing work over, sharing responsibilities and continuing to work together.
sentences.子午對廉相較易調和，寅申看武祿或破祿，辰戌仍保留見煞離散。: At Zi or Wu, with Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang opposite, harmony is easier to achieve; at Yin or Shen, look for Wu Qu turning to Abundance or Po Jun turning to Abundance; at Chen or Xu, the warning of separation when harsh stars appear still applies.
sentences.關鍵在於對方能提供甚麼，再看彼此怎樣交換意見。: Focus first on what the other person can offer, then on how you exchange views.
sentences.有代溝與沒有感情不是同一件事。: A generation gap is not the same as a lack of affection.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，太陰的疾厄論述，沿水濕與虛耗展開。: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional health readings, the discussion of Tai Yin follows the themes of water, dampness, deficiency and depletion.
sentences.要留意彼此是否相處融洽，以及工作與環境能否讓幫助延續。: Consider whether you get on well together, and whether work and your surroundings allow that help to continue.
sentences.如果對方只能幫一段時間，可以先說清楚階段與交接。: If the other person can only help for a while, agree at the outset how long that help will last and how it will be handed over.
sentences.紫微、貪狼同宮，原書有輔佐支持時可利遷移，但亦說原命已有良好條件時，未必非搬不可: With Zi Wei and Tan Lang in the same palace, the book says a move may be beneficial when supporting stars are present, but also says you may not need to move if your birth chart already has favourable conditions.
sentences.要把外在吸引與原有基礎一起比較。: Weigh the appeal of what is elsewhere alongside the foundations you already have.
sentences.有更多接觸面，不等於一定要離開。: Having a wider range of contacts does not mean you necessarily have to leave.
sentences.關鍵在於人員、職責與期待是否常改，再看交接能否跟得上。: Focus first on whether people, responsibilities and expectations change often, then on whether handovers can keep pace.
sentences.木的枝條被用來比喻手足。: The branches of a tree are used as a metaphor for the hands and feet.
sentences.地方舒適之後，費用、使用與維護仍要有人接住。: Once a place is comfortable, someone still needs to take responsibility for its costs, use and upkeep.
sentences.天同、太陰同宮，原書見吉的一支仍保留助力偏弱的提醒。: With Tian Tong and Tai Yin in the same palace, even the book's reading with favourable stars retains the warning that support is relatively weak.
sentences.要緊的是兩人能否好好相處，也要看對方的幫忙能否回應你的實際需要。: What matters is whether you get on well together, and whether the other person's help meets your practical needs.
sentences.有時對方能安慰你，卻未能接手工作，兩者不應互相取代。: Sometimes the other person can comfort you but cannot take on the work, and neither should stand in for the other.
sentences.要留意你的支援有沒有慢慢轉成對方自己的能力。: Notice whether your support is gradually helping the other person develop abilities of their own.
sentences.如果對方每一步都先問你，要分清哪些需要共同決定，哪些可以由他自行嘗試。: If the other person asks you before every step, distinguish what needs a joint decision from what they can try independently.
sentences.太陽落陷與入廟見煞，是兩種不同情況。: Tai Yang in a weak position and Tai Yang in a strong position with harsh stars are two different situations.
sentences.要留意外部市場如何開路，也看所得能否留下。: Look at how external markets open up opportunities, and whether you can retain what you gain.
sentences.天同、太陰同宮，原書有益友與多方面交往的一面，亦說不見吉曜時難持久。: With Tian Tong and Tai Yin in the same palace, the book describes helpful friends and a varied social circle, but also says these are hard to sustain without favourable stars.
sentences.關鍵在於支援能否在工作需要時繼續存在。: The key is whether support remains available when your work calls for it.
sentences.可以先對照哪些調整只是改善當下，哪些真正幫助你建立能夠持續使用的環境。: First compare which adjustments only improve things for now and which truly help you create an environment you can keep using.
sentences.機梁的變動既可以是遷動，也可以只是舊有空間翻修；眼前改得方便，與長期基礎建立得好: Changes associated with Tian Ji and Tian Liang may involve a move or simply renovating an existing space; making things convenient now and establishing sound foundations for the long term remain two different things.
sentences.關鍵在於工作上的溝通能否互相理解。: The key is whether you understand each other when you communicate at work.
sentences.家庭的離鄉背景與現時主管的工作方式不是同一件事。: Your family's history of moving away from home and your current supervisor's way of working are separate matters.
sentences.要緊的是支持與溝通各自的情況，不只問對方有沒有條件。: What matters is both the support you receive and how well you communicate, considered separately; look beyond whether the other person has the means to help.

sentences.父母或主管的處境、實際能提供的支援，以及雙方感情，不能只用一面代替其他。: Your parents' or supervisor's circumstances, the support they can actually offer and your emotional bond are separate aspects, and none can stand in for the others.
sentences.工作、住處或責任改變，可以令見面減少，卻未必代表反目。: Changes in your work, home or responsibilities may mean you meet less often, but do not necessarily mean you have fallen out.
sentences.你和朋友或同事共事時，可以把意見交流與利益分配分開談。: When you work with friends or colleagues, discuss the exchange of ideas separately from how you divide the benefits.
sentences.各自投入多少、怎樣使用資源、誰負責交代，先講清楚，再讓交情支持合作。: First clarify how much each person will contribute, how resources will be used and who will report back, then let your friendship support the collaboration.
sentences.要留意你投入一項興趣時，享受的是內容，還是附帶的熱鬧與外觀。: When you take up an interest, notice whether you enjoy the activity itself or the bustle and appearances that come with it.
sentences.巨門獨坐，原書基本提醒是費神，可能表現在事事過問或決定後反覆。: With Ju Men alone in this palace, the book's basic warning is mental strain, which may show as checking every detail or repeatedly revisiting decisions.
sentences.要留意你投入思考後，是否更能接受結果，還是仍想重新開始。: Notice whether thinking things through helps you accept the outcome or leaves you still wanting to start again.
sentences.巨門這裡要看思考有沒有帶來新的理解。: With Ju Men here, consider whether your thinking has brought new understanding.
sentences.已有足夠資訊之後，是否仍一次次重開同一個問題，與真正需要補資料，是不同的情況。: Repeatedly reopening the same question when you already have enough information is different from genuinely needing more information.
sentences.巨門獨坐，原書偏重口舌求財與在外以言詞取信，但要連太陽的配合一起看。: With Ju Men alone in this palace, the book emphasises earning through speaking and gaining people's trust through your words away from home, but this needs to be read alongside Tai Yang's influence.
sentences.要留意新環境能否理解你的專長與表達。: Consider whether people in a new environment can understand your expertise and how you express yourself.
sentences.關鍵在於雙方能否聽完對方的理由，而不是只看誰說得多。: The key is whether you both listen to each other's reasons in full, rather than simply who speaks more.
sentences.可以留意對方表達不同意見時，你是否還能分清內容與情緒。: When the other person disagrees, notice whether you can still distinguish what they are saying from the emotions involved.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，太陽、巨門同度，原書先看太陽的廟陷，牽涉陽分的盛衰。: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional health readings, when Tai Yang and Ju Men share a palace, the book first considers whether Tai Yang occupies a strong or weak position, which relates to the strength or weakness of the body's yang aspect.
sentences.想改哪裡、準備了甚麼、實際完成了甚麼，是三個不同階段。: What you want to change, what you have prepared and what you have actually completed are three different stages.
sentences.要留意你關心的是探索本身，還是一直替人事與責任費神。: Notice whether your attention goes to exploration itself or to continually worrying about people, affairs and responsibilities.
sentences.天梁把探索與原則放在精神生活裡。: Tian Liang brings exploration and principles into your inner life.
sentences.投入一個問題可以帶來理解與樂趣，替所有人事持續把關則是另一份心力；兩者都認真，所: Exploring a question can bring understanding and enjoyment, while continually keeping watch over everyone and everything takes a different kind of mental effort; both involve commitment, but need different rhythms.
sentences.本宮有科文的配合，原書以「文星入宅」形容。: Recognition and literary stars are present together in this palace, which the book describes as 'literary stars entering the home'.
sentences.天同、巨門同宮，原書見吉的一支仍有勞心得財，並分同度與對拱的感情、口舌輕重。: With Tian Tong and Ju Men in the same palace, even the book's reading with favourable stars involves earning through mental effort, and it distinguishes the emotional bond and degree of verbal conflict according to whether the stars share a palace or face each other from opposite palaces.
sentences.關鍵在於對外溝通需要付出多少。: The key is how much effort you need to put into communicating with people outside your immediate circle.
sentences.留意事情上的解釋與私人交情是否混在一起。: Notice whether explanations about practical matters become mixed up with personal friendships.
sentences.要留意你關心的事情是否真的值得持續投入。: Consider whether the things that concern you are truly worth your continued effort.
sentences.太陽在福德宮，原書說夜生人一般均主不得寧靜；只有丑未日月同度者例外。: With Tai Yang in your Wellbeing Palace, the book says that if you were born at night, you generally find it hard to feel at peace; the only exception is when Tai Yang and Tai Yin share the palace at Chou or Wei.

sentences.太陽獨坐子午，原書須連日夜、廟陷及輔曜才論原有基礎與自置。: When Tai Yang sits alone in Zi or Wu, the book requires you to consider a day or night birth, whether the star is in a strong or weak position, and supporting stars before discussing existing foundations and what you acquire yourself.
sentences.這組要分清可接觸的資源，與能否長期使用；未按原書逐項確認廟陷等條件時，不由亮度便: With these stars, distinguish access to resources from being able to use them long term; until you have checked each condition in the book, including strong and weak positions, do not infer the actual state of your family assets from brightness alone.

sentences.要留意改變是否讓事情前進，還是只換了一種忙法。: Notice whether a change moves things forward or simply gives you a different way to stay busy.
sentences.天相獨坐，原書對府庫與夾宮非常重視。: When Tian Xiang sits alone, the book places great importance on Tian Fu's store of resources and the palaces that flank this palace.
sentences.如果需要你一再補位，要分清是經驗不足，還是權限從未交清楚。: If you repeatedly need to step in, distinguish a lack of experience from authority that was never clearly handed over.

However stable the relationship feels, that stability still needs to be reflected in their ability to take on formal work.

sentences.陽梁這裡把能力的培育放在前面：有興趣之後，還需要持續練習、方法與回饋，才逐步形成: Tai Yang and Tian Liang put developing your abilities first here: once you have an interest, you still need sustained practice, methods and feedback to gradually build expertise.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，天同、巨門的疾厄取象，以管道為主線，書中談食道、氣管與腸道: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of health, Tian Tong and Ju Men are mainly associated with passages in the body; the book discusses the oesophagus, windpipe and intestines, extending to nerve compression, changes in bone growth and pain.
sentences.呼吸與筋骨兩面的描述，都要連這些位置一起理解。: You need to read the descriptions of both breathing and the muscles and bones alongside these locations in the body.
sentences.正文的取象涉及消化與腸胃、呼吸、筋骨與疼痛。: The main text's symbolic associations concern digestion and the stomach and intestines, breathing, muscles and bones, and pain.
sentences.要留意的是資源由誰管理、誰能使用，以及責任怎樣分擔。: Pay attention to who manages the resources, who can use them and how responsibilities are shared.
sentences.原書對陽梁的吉煞另列管理與糾紛分支，不能把所有資源都當成你能獨自支配。: For Tai Yang and Tian Liang, the book gives separate readings about management and disputes according to the favourable and harsh stars, so you cannot treat all resources as yours alone to control.
sentences.關鍵在於你們說的是同一件事，還是各自有未表明的期待。: The key is whether you are both talking about the same thing or each holding expectations you have not expressed.
sentences.對方能提供多少，與你真正希望被理解的部分，可能是不同事情；兩邊都講清楚，才知道分: How much the other person can offer and what you really want them to understand may be different things; explain both clearly so you can see where the disagreement comes from.
sentences.你和親友共同投入金錢或資源時，可以先把各自投入多少、如何使用、成果怎樣分配寫清楚: When you contribute money or resources jointly with family or friends, first write down clearly how much each person will contribute, how it will be used and how the results will be shared.
sentences.事情有變就重新談，讓交情和共同責任都有交代。: Talk things through again if circumstances change, so that both your relationship and your shared responsibilities receive proper attention.
sentences.可以先看兩個人怎樣處理分工，而不是以表面客氣就推成合作順利。: Start by looking at how you divide the work between you, rather than assuming that outward politeness means cooperation will go smoothly.
sentences.若常在最後決定才發現方向不同，可以回看雙方何時開始有不同期待。: If you often discover that you want different things only when making the final decision, look back at when your expectations began to diverge.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，武曲、天府同宮，原書特別指出：天府在這裡受武曲影響，以肺經: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of health, when Wu Qu and Tian Fu share the palace, the book specifically states that Wu Qu influences Tian Fu here, making the lung meridian its main symbolic association, with further descriptions including surges of phlegm and asthma.
sentences.這組不能只沿天府獨坐的胃部取象理解。: You cannot understand these stars solely through the stomach associations used for Tian Fu sitting alone.
sentences.忌星、煞曜與其他配合，仍決定原文接著走向哪一支。: Stars turning to Obstruction, harsh stars and the other stars involved still determine which reading the original text follows next.
sentences.廉貞獨坐田宅宮，原書不只談退去祖業，也談自行建立時的困擾與糾紛。: When Lian Zhen sits alone in your Property Palace, the book discusses both losing inherited property and the difficulties and disputes involved in building up your own property holdings.
sentences.要留意的是資源安排如何落實，以及哪些地方需要協調。: Pay attention to how arrangements for resources are put into practice and where coordination is needed.
sentences.廉貞這裡要留意重建過程中的安排與協調。: With Lian Zhen here, pay attention to arrangements and coordination during rebuilding.
sentences.資源怎樣落實，仍要按實際位置理解。: You still need to interpret how resources become available according to the actual star positions.
sentences.要留意教導與照顧投入了甚麼，也看對方是否有回應需要的空間。: Notice what you put into teaching and caring for the other person, and whether they have room to respond to needs.
sentences.這組要讓期待有說明的機會，也容許對方在成長之後改變做法，才不會只剩自己一方不停操: With these stars, make sure there is an opportunity to explain expectations, and allow the other person to change how they do things as they grow, so that you are not left doing all the worrying.
sentences.天同、天梁同宮，原書有命宮較弱、遷移會吉後在外得提拔的一支，也要求分寅與申。: When Tian Tong and Tian Liang share the palace, one reading in the book describes a weaker Life Palace, with favourable stars linked to your Travel Palace bringing advancement away from home, and it also requires a distinction between Yin and Shen.
sentences.要留意外面的資源是否真正補上現有不足。: Notice whether resources from elsewhere really make up for what you currently lack.
sentences.關鍵在於資源如何維持，不只看曾否得到或一時增加。: The key is how you sustain resources, not just whether you have received them or seen a temporary increase.
sentences.一時得到資源，不能代替之後能否持續管理與使用。: Receiving resources for a time does not answer whether you can keep managing and using them afterwards.
sentences.天梁獨坐，原書較重精神享受與原則，也要看同拱太陽、天同或天機。: When Tian Liang sits alone, the book places more emphasis on inner fulfilment and principles, while also considering support from Tai Yang, Tian Tong or Tian Ji.
sentences.同宮主星又能使這條主線改變。: A major star sharing the palace can also change this main theme.
sentences.一時規模擴大，仍要連維持成本與協調負荷一起看。: When things expand for a time, you still need to consider the cost of maintaining them and the work involved in coordinating them.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，紫微、貪狼的疾厄取象，沿木、水、土之間的牽動展開，重點落在: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of health, the symbolic associations of Zi Wei and Tan Lang follow the interactions between wood, water and earth, focusing on the kidneys and reproductive system as classified in classical texts.
sentences.天機、太陰同宮，原書見祿較利在外求財，仍保留終日忙碌；吉煞交集亦有得財與是非並見: When Tian Ji and Tai Yin share the palace, the book sees Abundance as more favourable for earning money away from home, while still describing you as busy all day; when favourable and harsh stars meet, financial gains can also come with disputes.
sentences.這組要把新增機會與往返、協調的時間一起看，評估新安排是否能持續。: With these stars, weigh new opportunities alongside the time needed for travel and coordination to assess whether you can sustain the new arrangements.
sentences.留意新增工作需要多少時間與往返。: Notice how much time and travel the additional work requires.
sentences.關鍵在於客觀安排，不把少聚直接當成不被愛護。: The key is to look at the practical arrangements, rather than taking less time together as a direct sign that you are not loved or cared for.
sentences.距離改變後，照顧可能換一種形式延續。: When the distance between you changes, care may continue in a different form.
sentences.紫微、貪狼同宮，原書特別分清兄長或朋友發展得好，與自己能否得到幫助。: When Zi Wei and Tan Lang share the palace, the book carefully distinguishes between an elder brother or friend doing well and whether you receive help yourself.
sentences.可以留意對方實際投入多少時間、資源與承擔。: Notice how much the other person actually contributes in time and resources, and how much responsibility they take on.
sentences.可以先對照：當兩個人對同一件事有不同感受時，是否仍能說明需要，而不是只留下猜測。: Start by checking whether, when you feel differently about the same thing, you can still explain your needs to each other rather than leaving each other guessing.
sentences.機陰的分歧要分清感受與實際要求。: With Tian Ji and Tai Yin, you need to distinguish feelings from practical requests when disagreements arise.
sentences.要緊的是交情之後，工作能否穩定交接。: What matters is whether, beyond the personal relationship, work can be handed over reliably.
sentences.紫貪這裡要把往來的熱度接到正式工作。: With Zi Wei and Tan Lang here, you need to carry the warmth of your interactions into formal working arrangements.
sentences.關係開始得熱絡之後，能否按時交付、留下資料並持續回應，才看得出這份支持可以用在哪: After a warm start to the relationship, whether work is delivered on time, records are kept and responses continue shows you at which stage this support can help.
sentences.天機、太陰同宮，原書較重在既有基礎發展，另按祿權科與配曜細分。: When Tian Ji and Tai Yin share the palace, the book places more emphasis on building on existing foundations, with further distinctions according to Abundance, Authority, Recognition and the supporting stars.
sentences.要留意工作如何依賴籌劃，以及你能否把計劃落到現有資源。: Notice how your work depends on planning and whether you can put your plans into practice with the resources you already have.
sentences.機陰這裡要把計劃放回現有基礎：有哪些資源可用、方案由誰執行、完成後怎樣跟進。: With Tian Ji and Tai Yin here, ground your plans in what you already have: which resources are available, who will carry out the plan and how you will follow up once it is complete.
sentences.籌劃得周到與真正落實，是這組工作中需要接起來的兩步。: With these stars, you need to connect two steps in your work: thorough planning and putting the plan into practice.
sentences.紫微、破軍同宮，原書偏重憑新做法開創，並明說開展後仍難閒下來。: When Zi Wei and Po Jun share the palace, the book emphasises breaking new ground through new methods and explicitly says that you still find it hard to slow down once things are under way.
sentences.要留意你的工作是否常需要解決新問題，而不是只看有沒有轉工。: Notice whether your work often requires you to solve new problems, rather than looking only at whether you change jobs.
sentences.破祿可以增加額外工作，破權亦保留波折；有財源未必收成就大。: Po Jun turning to Abundance can bring additional work, while Po Jun turning to Authority still involves setbacks; having a source of income does not necessarily mean large returns.
sentences.留意開拓之後有沒有可交接、維持的流程。: Notice whether, after breaking new ground, you have processes that can be handed over and maintained.
sentences.天機獨坐子午，原書的基本變動主題可用來參照住處與工作環境；關鍵在於安排變了甚麼，: When Tian Ji sits alone at Zi or Wu, you can use the book's basic theme of change to consider your home and work environment; the key is to identify what has changed in the arrangements, then assess whether the result suits you.
sentences.武曲、破軍同宮，原書即使在見吉化、吉曜而配偶精明的一支，仍保留自身受配偶主導的提: When Wu Qu and Po Jun share the palace, the book still cautions that your spouse takes the dominant role, even in the case with favourable transformations, favourable stars and an astute spouse.
sentences.火鈴同度即使有祿也保留限制，機忌與巨忌又是不同變化。: When Huo Xing and Ling Xing share the palace, limits still apply even with Abundance, while Tian Ji turning to Obstruction and Ju Men turning to Obstruction bring different developments.
sentences.武曲、貪狼同宮，原書較重物質與感官享受，也按科文、桃花與火星另論。: When Wu Qu and Tan Lang share the palace, the book places more emphasis on material and sensory pleasures, with separate readings according to Recognition, literary stars, romance stars and Huo Xing.
sentences.巳亥天府與紫微七殺相對，原書談配偶能力，也要求看天相的夾宮。: With Tian Fu at Si or Hai opposite Zi Wei and Qi Sha, the book discusses your spouse's abilities and also requires you to consider the stars flanking Tian Xiang's palace.
sentences.天機、太陰同宮，原書在這組配置中提出情緒化過甚所帶來的波折。: When Tian Ji and Tai Yin share the palace, the book identifies setbacks brought about by being overly emotional.
sentences.武貪這裡要分清突然增加與之後保留：火貪、鈴貪有資源突然增值的描述，見羊陀空劫刑耗: With Wu Qu and Tan Lang here, distinguish a sudden increase from what you retain afterwards: Huo Xing with Tan Lang and Ling Xing with Tan Lang are described as bringing sudden increases in the value of resources, but the book still describes losses when Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Di Kong, Di Jie and stars associated with punishment and depletion are present.
sentences.丑未天相與紫微破軍相對，原書重視火鈴羊陀的同度，以及對宮左右夾的不同作用。: With Tian Xiang at Chou or Wei opposite Zi Wei and Po Jun, the book gives particular weight to Huo Xing, Ling Xing, Qing Yang and Tuo Luo sharing the palace, and to the different effects of Zuo Fu and You Bi flanking the opposite palace.
sentences.廉貞、貪狼同宮，原書有受到差遣、怨責與感情變化的分支。: When Lian Zhen and Tan Lang share the palace, the book includes readings involving being sent on tasks, facing resentment and blame, and changes in your emotional relationships.
sentences.要留意的是彼此幫忙是否出於自願，以及要求有沒有逐漸失去平衡。: Notice whether you help each other willingly and whether demands are gradually becoming unbalanced.
sentences.要留意交際如何真正接上工作。: Notice how your social connections actually feed into your work.
sentences.實際承諾仍要回到共同事情。: Your practical commitments still need to relate to what you are doing together.
sentences.要留意你能否在得到照顧之後，仍主動選擇自己的方向。: Notice whether you can still actively choose your own direction after receiving care.
sentences.同梁這裡要把得到照顧與主動選擇接起來。: With Tian Tong and Tian Liang here, you need to connect receiving care with making your own choices.
sentences.環境安穩之後，仍要有自己願意投入的方向，才知道享受來自甚麼，而不只是隨安排往前走: Once your surroundings are stable, you still need a direction you want to commit to, so you know where your enjoyment comes from rather than simply following the arrangements made.
sentences.天府化科是本盤可確認的配置，但原書在疾厄使用吉化的方式與財帛、官祿不同，還受同宮: Your chart confirms Tian Fu turning to Recognition, but the book uses favourable transformations differently in the Health Palace from the Wealth Palace and Career Palace, with the major star sharing the palace also influencing the reading.
sentences.天機與火鈴同度，原書明說主離不主克。: When Tian Ji shares the palace with Huo Xing and Ling Xing, the book explicitly says this indicates separation rather than harm.
sentences.紫微、破軍同宮，原書即使談到本質安定的一支，仍保留婚前波折的提醒。: When Zi Wei and Po Jun share the palace, even the book's reading of an essentially stable relationship still cautions about setbacks before marriage.
sentences.因此，開始的投入不能代替之後的分工與相處。: Your initial commitment therefore cannot take the place of how you later share responsibilities and get along.
sentences.武曲、七殺同宮，原書明說見吉也未必清閒。: When Wu Qu and Qi Sha share the palace, the book explicitly says that even favourable stars do not necessarily give you an easy life.
sentences.真正要緊的是外在挑戰與自己能否持續承擔，不只把工作多寫成機會多。: What really matters is the challenges you face and whether you can keep shouldering them, rather than simply describing more work as more opportunities.
sentences.巨門獨坐子午，與天機相對，這組要留意資源安排中的意見與變動。: When Ju Men sits alone at Zi or Wu opposite Tian Ji, pay attention to views and changes concerning arrangements for resources.
sentences.需要調整時，使用、責任與決定能否談清楚，比只看現成條件更能說明這一章的重點。: When adjustments are needed, whether you can clearly discuss use, responsibility and decisions tells you more about this chapter's focus than the existing conditions alone.
sentences.須將支持條件看齊，才談相處的穩定，不由一顆吉曜包辦。: You need to consider all the supporting conditions before judging how stable your relationships are; one favourable star cannot account for everything.
sentences.要留意需要的是管理協調，還是直接操作工具、技術與流程。: Notice whether you need to manage and coordinate or work directly with tools, techniques and processes.
sentences.共同安排仍要談到彼此理解，免得只靠揣測對方的反應。: Keep discussing shared arrangements until you understand each other, so you do not have to rely on guessing each other's reactions.
sentences.太陰入廟守僕役宮，原書說夜生人交遊廣闊，且得益友。: With Tai Yin in its strongest position in your Friends Palace, the book says that if you were born at night, you have a wide social circle and friends who benefit you.
sentences.天機獨坐丑未，對宮天梁。: Tian Ji sits alone at Chou or Wei, with Tian Liang in the opposite palace.
sentences.原書以陀羅、擎羊同度，分別談肺經與大腸；眼目的較重描述，另有煞忌、刑曜與雜曜配合: The book discusses the lung meridian when Tuo Luo shares the palace and the large intestine when Qing Yang does; its more serious descriptions concerning the eyes involve further arrangements of harsh stars, Obstruction, stars associated with punishment and minor stars.
sentences.要留意的是分歧怎樣處理，以及合作能否在需要改變時重新談妥。: Notice how you handle disagreements and whether you can agree fresh terms for working together when changes are needed.
sentences.一次事情做得好，未能代替往後的分工安排。: Doing something well once does not take the place of arrangements for sharing future work.
sentences.要分清對方的能力、自己的期待，以及碰到不同想法時能否重新商量。: Distinguish between the other person's abilities, your own expectations and whether you can discuss things again when your views differ.
sentences.可以觀察你提供的意見是讓對方更清楚，還是替對方作完所有決定。: Notice whether your advice helps the other person see things more clearly or makes all their decisions for them.
sentences.要緊的是共同工作時是否把承諾與理解說清楚，而不只依賴熟悉感。: What matters when you work together is whether you clearly explain your commitments and understanding, rather than relying only on familiarity.
sentences.口頭上答應與彼此理解一致是兩件事。: Agreeing verbally and sharing the same understanding are two different things.
sentences.關鍵在於資源能否持續使用，不因日月同宮便保證家業興隆。: The key is whether your resources remain available to use; Tai Yang and Tai Yin sharing the palace does not by itself promise prosperity for your family.
sentences.日月這裡既看增添，也看資源的流動。: With Tai Yang and Tai Yin here, you need to consider both additions to your resources and how they flow.
sentences.關鍵在於彼此能否把不同期待說出來。: The key is whether you can express your differing expectations to each other.
sentences.可以觀察是否只問事情做完沒有，還是也願意聽對方的理由。: Notice whether you only ask if something is finished or are also willing to hear the other person's reasons.
sentences.依王亭之的傳統疾厄論，太陽、太陰同宮，原書從陰陽配合談眼目與虛實。: In Wang Tingzhi's traditional interpretation of health, when Tai Yang and Tai Yin share the palace, the book discusses the eyes and the traditional categories of deficiency and excess through the interaction of yin and yang.
sentences.正文的取象涉及眼目。: The main text's symbolic associations concern the eyes.
sentences.天機、巨門同宮，原書把產業安排、應動未動及糾紛放在一起討論。: When Tian Ji and Ju Men share the palace, the book discusses property arrangements, failing to make needed changes and disputes together.
sentences.要留意的是需要調整時有甚麼阻力，以及相關安排是否已說清楚。: Notice what resistance you face when adjustments are needed and whether the relevant arrangements have been clearly discussed.
sentences.機巨的調整，還牽涉安排與他人能否談妥。: With Tian Ji and Ju Men, making adjustments also depends on whether you can agree the arrangements with others.
sentences.因此，想改變、能落實，以及改完能否維持，要分成三步理解。: You therefore need to understand wanting change, being able to put it into practice and whether you can sustain it afterwards as three separate steps.
sentences.太陽、太陰同宮，原書有家庭關係較佳的一面，但對主管關係又提醒感情太重可能不思獨立: When Tai Yang and Tai Yin share the palace, the book describes a more favourable side to family relationships, but cautions that strong emotional attachment in your relationship with a manager may leave you with little desire for independence.
sentences.要緊的是支持是否也保留自己的判斷空間。: What matters is whether the support you receive also leaves room for your own judgement.
sentences.日月這裡要讓支持與獨立並行。: With Tai Yang and Tai Yin here, you need room for both support and independence.
sentences.有人願意照顧、願意提攜之後，自己仍需逐步形成判斷；關係中的感情，不能代替對責任與: Even when someone is willing to care for you and help you progress, you still need to develop your own judgement gradually; affection in the relationship cannot replace clear communication about responsibilities and expectations.
sentences.紫微、貪狼同宮，原書對火鈴的說法並不是財帛章的突然發達，而是晚輩表現與相處上的修: When Zi Wei and Tan Lang share a palace, the book uses Huo Xing and Ling Xing to qualify how younger people fare and how you get on with them, rather than to indicate the sudden prosperity described in the Wealth chapter.
sentences.可以先對照，哪些事情需要堅持，哪些需要兩個人一起調整。: First, look at where you need to stand firm and where both of you need to make adjustments together.
sentences.廉貞、天府同宮，原書有穩步發展的一面，亦要求看府庫與天相夾宮。: When Lian Zhen and Tian Fu share a palace, the book describes the possibility of steady progress, but also calls for checking Tian Fu's reserves and the palaces flanking Tian Xiang.
sentences.關鍵在於現成機會是否真的可使用，不把安定外觀當作資源充裕。: What matters is whether you can actually use the opportunities already available, without assuming that an appearance of stability means plentiful resources.
sentences.外面的基礎既可能帶來機會，也可能附帶限制。: The foundations available to you elsewhere may bring opportunities, but may also come with limits.
sentences.原書按不同配合分述，關鍵是資源與支持能否真正接到自己手上。: The book discusses different arrangements of stars separately; what matters is whether the resources and support actually reach you.
sentences.要留意你完成決定之後，是否還能接受不同意見與別人的分擔。: Notice whether, once you have made a decision, you can still accept different views and let others share the load.
sentences.有能力處理事情，未必自然少操心。: Being able to handle things does not necessarily mean you will naturally worry less.
