sentences.你較能從作品的細節、形式與韻味得到精神享受，也會有自己的評價；感受敏銳，不代表凡: You are more able to find inner enjoyment in a work's details, form and subtle character, and will also have your own judgement of it; being sensitive does not mean that everything pleases you.
sentences.廉貞化忌的多思慮仍在，喜歡一件作品、投入一項興趣，也未必就能隨遇而安。: You still have the tendency to dwell on things associated with Lian Zhen turning to Obstruction, so enjoying a work or devoting yourself to an interest may not be enough to help you feel at ease with whatever comes.
sentences.你可以替真正喜歡的作品或興趣留一段固定時間，把「欣賞它」和「把它做好」分開。: Set aside a regular time for works or interests you truly enjoy, and separate appreciating them from doing them well.
sentences.想修改時，先定一個這次要處理的重點，做到便收住；讓敏銳的眼光有用處，也讓享受不必: When you want to make changes, first choose one thing to focus on this time and stop once you have dealt with it; put your keen eye to use while letting yourself enjoy things without turning that enjoyment into another demand every time.
sentences.書中既談土氣偏重，也留意火鈴加入後，這條主線如何改變。: The book discusses an excess of Earth, and also notes how this theme changes once Huo Xing or Ling Xing joins.
sentences.同梁在僕役，即使天同化祿，原書仍有因財起誤會的提醒。: With Tian Tong and Tian Liang in your Friends Palace, the book still warns of misunderstandings over money, even when Tian Tong turns to Abundance.
sentences.子午貪狼與紫微相對，原書最喜刑曜或空曜同度；貪狼見之，原書亦說程度減輕，主能克制: With Tan Lang in Zi or Wu opposite Zi Wei, the book most favours Tian Xing, Di Kong or Di Jie in the same palace; when Tan Lang has one of them, the book also says its pull is milder and you are able to hold back.
sentences.本宮紫微化科，原書又提醒主觀的一面；這一宮先按紫殺的責任與照顧主題來讀：實際得到: Zi Wei turns to Recognition in this palace, and the book also warns of a subjective side; read this palace first through the themes of responsibility and care that Zi Wei and Qi Sha bring: the support you actually receive, how the other person makes arrangements and whether your needs are heard each need watching separately.
sentences.廉貞、七殺同宮，原書明列火鈴同度可能分離，但廉貞化祿仍可感情深厚。: With Lian Zhen and Qi Sha in the same palace, the book explicitly lists possible separation if Huo Xing or Ling Xing is there too, but with Lian Zhen turning to Abundance the bond can still be deep.
sentences.本組見祿，原書仍保留因利益起紛爭的提醒。: These stars meet Abundance, but the book still warns of disputes over money and interests.
sentences.太陰在亥宮化忌，原書另有配偶能協助自己事業、自己亦有事業的說法。: With Tai Yin turning to Obstruction in Hai, the book also says your spouse can help with your career, and that you have a career of your own as well.
sentences.合作是否適合，仍要另外看實際安排。: Whether working together suits you still depends on the practical arrangements, which need a separate look.
sentences.本盤把兩者一起讀，不能把距離的提醒改寫成感情已經破裂。: Your chart reads the two together; a note about distance cannot be turned into a claim that the relationship has broken down.
sentences.你在這些方面有不舒服時，可以告訴家人或照顧者哪裡不適、何時開始；反覆或持續不適，: If you feel unwell in any of these ways, tell your family or carer where you feel uncomfortable and when it started; if it keeps coming back or does not go away, ask an adult to go with you to see a doctor and explain clearly how you feel.
sentences.將來談感情時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做。: In future romantic relationships, allow a little extra time; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.有分歧就一起找下一步，別只爭誰的做法比較好。: If you disagree, work out the next step together instead of just arguing over whose approach is better.
sentences.你可以和家人確認哪些學習用品、空間與支援能固定使用，再安排自己的需要。: Check with your family which learning materials, space and support you can use regularly, then plan for what you need.
sentences.先把已有條件用穩，想增加時就說清楚用途與之後怎樣照料。: First get used to making good use of what you have, and if you want more, explain what it is for and how you will look after it.
sentences.你帶低年級同學時，可以先示範，再讓對方自己排流程。: When you guide younger pupils, show them how first, then let them plan the steps themselves.
sentences.說清楚要完成甚麼，也容許對方用自己的方法試做。: Explain clearly what needs to be done, and let them try their own way of doing it.
sentences.你到新環境時，可以先熟悉每天的安排，找到能放心請教的老師或同學。: When you enter a new setting, first get to know the daily routine and find a teacher or classmate you feel comfortable asking for help.
sentences.把日常過順了，再逐步增加活動。: Once your daily routine is running smoothly, gradually add more activities.
sentences.除了把生活安排好，也要願意說自己的心事，並認真聽對方最近在意甚麼。: As well as organising daily life, be willing to share what is on your mind and listen carefully to what has been on your partner's mind lately.
sentences.你帶低年級同學時，可以隨著對方學會更多，逐步調整分工。: When you guide younger pupils, gradually adjust how you share the tasks as they learn more.
sentences.讓他知道哪些能自己決定、哪些可以找你商量，別一直沿用最初的要求。: Let them know what they can decide themselves and what they can discuss with you, rather than keeping the original expectations unchanged.
sentences.和弟妹或低年級同學相處時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再: Allow a little extra time with younger siblings or pupils; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你和父母或照顧者有不同想法時，可以一次說一件事，把自己的需要講清楚。: If you and your parents or carers see things differently, explain one thing at a time and be clear about what you need.
sentences.聽不懂要求，就請對方再解釋，一起確認接下來怎樣做。: If you do not understand what they are asking, ask them to explain again and agree together on what to do next.
sentences.和同學、朋友合作時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做: Allow a little extra time when you work with classmates or friends; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你和父母或照顧者分開一段時間時，可以約好怎樣聯絡、有事找誰。: When you spend time apart from your parents or carers, agree on how to stay in touch and who to go to if something comes up.
sentences.想念、擔心或需要幫忙，就直接告訴可信任的大人。: If you miss them, feel worried or need help, tell an adult you trust directly.
sentences.你需要父母或照顧者幫忙時，可以說清楚缺甚麼、哪一步不會做。: When you need help from your parents or carers, explain clearly what you are missing and which step you do not know how to do.
sentences.得到協助後，試著自己完成可以負責的部分，再告訴他們進展。: Once you have had help, try to finish the parts you can take responsibility for yourself, then tell them how you are getting on.
sentences.處理功課和活動時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做。: Allow a little extra time for homework and activities; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你想整理房間或調整學習空間時，可以先選最不方便的一處，和家人談好怎樣改、甚麼時候: If you want to tidy your room or change your study space, start with the part that is most awkward to use and agree with your family on how to change it and when to finish.
sentences.做完試用一段時間，再決定要不要改其他部分。: Try it for a while once it is done, then decide whether to change anything else.
sentences.和父母、老師相處時，可以多留一點緩衝時間；急著決定的事，先確認關鍵細節，再往下做: Allow a little extra time when dealing with your parents or teachers; if you are in a hurry to make a decision, check the key details before going ahead.
sentences.你想添置用品或改房間擺設時，可以先想每天會怎樣用、放在哪裡、由誰收拾。: If you want new things or a different room layout, first think about how you will use them each day, where they will go and who will put them away.
sentences.原有空間用得順，再和家人商量想加的部分，別只憑外觀決定。: Once your existing space works well, discuss any additions with your family rather than deciding just by how they look.
sentences.你可以留意哪些活動做完真的開心、哪些只是停不下來。: Notice which activities leave you feeling happy and which you simply find hard to stop.
sentences.為喜歡的事安排時間，也替睡眠、功課和安靜獨處留位置。: Make time for things you enjoy, and leave room for sleep, homework and quiet time on your own too.
sentences.你擔任小組負責人時，可以先問清楚自己能決定甚麼、哪些事要請示老師。: When you lead a group, first ask what you can decide yourself and what you need to ask a teacher about.
sentences.把分工和完成時間講明白，也留意組員需要甚麼協助。: Be clear about who will do what and when it needs to be finished, and notice what help your group members need.
sentences.你想自己作決定時，可以先和父母或照顧者說清楚打算怎樣做。: If you want to make a decision yourself, first explain clearly to your parents or carers what you plan to do.
sentences.聽聽他們擔心甚麼，再商量哪些部分可以讓你自己試。: Listen to their worries, then discuss which parts you can try yourself.
sentences.生活有變時，一起重排見面與聯絡，別讓忙碌代替了所有交代。: When life changes, rearrange time together and contact with each other, rather than letting being busy become the only explanation you give.
sentences.你參加要往返不同地方的活動前，可以和家人把交通、功課與休息時間一起安排。: Before you join activities that involve travelling between places, plan travel, homework and rest time together with your family.
sentences.需要別人接送或幫忙，就及早說清楚。: If you need someone to take you, collect you or help, explain this clearly in good time.
sentences.你加入新小組時，可以先問清楚自己負責甚麼、可以找誰幫忙。: When you join a new group, first ask what you are responsible for and who you can ask for help.
sentences.把分內的事完成，再逐步接下更多工作。: Finish your own tasks, then gradually take on more work.
sentences.和同學、朋友合作時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投: When you work with classmates or friends and support or an opportunity becomes available, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to put into it.
sentences.和弟妹或低年級同學相處時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再: When you are with younger siblings or pupils and support or an opportunity becomes available, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to put into it.
sentences.處理功課和活動時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投入: For homework and activities, if support or an opportunity becomes available, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to put into it.
sentences.處理功課和活動時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: For homework and activities, seek out someone reliable to discuss things with and be clear about what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.你帶低年級同學做事時，先聽對方怎樣想，再一起看成果。: When you guide younger pupils through a task, first listen to their ideas, then look at the results together.
sentences.要求可以說清楚，也留空間讓對方提出不同方法。: Explain clearly what is needed, and leave room for them to suggest different ways of doing it.
sentences.你做報告或小組討論時，可以先整理問題、理由和結論，再練習說給別人聽。: For a presentation or group discussion, first organise the questions, reasons and conclusions, then practise explaining them to others.
sentences.聽到不同意見，就找出哪一點需要補充資料。: If you hear a different view, identify which point needs more information.
sentences.和父母、老師相處時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投: When dealing with your parents or teachers, if support or an opportunity becomes available, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to put into it.
sentences.你身體不舒服時，要把哪裡不適、何時開始告訴家人或照顧者。: When you feel unwell, tell your family or carer where you feel uncomfortable and when it started.
sentences.腫脹持續不退或加重，就請大人陪你尋求醫療評估。: If swelling does not go down or gets worse, ask an adult to go with you to have it assessed by a medical professional.
sentences.將來談感情時，遇到可用的支持或機會，先記下它從哪裡來、能維持多久，再決定投入多少: In future romantic relationships, if support or an opportunity becomes available, first note where it comes from and how long it can last, then decide how much to put into it.
sentences.你到新班級或活動時，可以主動打招呼、問清楚規則。: When you join a new class or activity, introduce yourself and ask about the rules.
sentences.遇到聽不懂或不確定的安排，找老師或負責同學確認。: If you do not understand an arrangement or are unsure about it, check with a teacher or the pupil in charge.
sentences.和同學、朋友合作時，可以把原本的預期和實際情況分開記下；出現落差時，先調整做法和: When you work with classmates or friends, make separate notes of what you expected and what actually happens; if they differ, first adjust your approach and pace, without having to scrap the whole plan at once.
sentences.和父母、老師相處時，可以把原本的預期和實際情況分開記下；出現落差時，先調整做法和: When dealing with your parents or teachers, make separate notes of what you expected and what actually happens; if they differ, first adjust your approach and pace, without having to scrap the whole plan at once.
sentences.你可以選一項有興趣的能力持續練習，遇到不懂的地方找老師請教。: Choose a skill that interests you and keep practising it, asking a teacher for help with anything you do not understand.
sentences.把學到的知識用在作品或實際任務上，看看自己還需要補甚麼。: Use what you have learnt in something you make or a practical task, and see what else you need to learn.
sentences.你和手足或同學一起做事時，先約好誰負責甚麼。: When you work with siblings or classmates, agree first on who is responsible for what.
sentences.有人時間有變，就及早交接資料和進度，讓合作接得下去。: If anyone's availability changes, hand over the information and progress updates in good time so the work can continue.
sentences.願意照顧對方，也要聽對方的選擇，讓彼此都能參與共同生活。: Be willing to care for your partner and listen to their choices too, so you both have a part in your shared life.
sentences.你和低年級同學或後輩相處時，要留空間讓對方自己成長。: When you spend time with younger pupils or those less experienced than you, give them room to grow for themselves.
sentences.分開學習或參加不同活動後，可以約好怎樣保持聯絡，不必事事在旁才算關心。: Once you study separately or join different activities, agree on how to keep in touch; you do not have to be there for everything to show you care.
sentences.你和家人共用房間、書桌或設備時，可以先談清楚使用時間、收拾與維修分擔。: If you share a room, desk or equipment with your family, first agree on when each person will use it and how to share tidying and repairs.
sentences.想改安排就一起確認，讓每個人都知道自己可以用甚麼、要負責甚麼。: If you want to change the arrangement, agree on it together so everyone knows what they can use and what they are responsible for.
sentences.和父母、老師相處時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: When dealing with your parents or teachers, seek out someone reliable to discuss things with and be clear about what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.和同學、朋友合作時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: When you work with classmates or friends, seek out someone reliable to discuss things with and be clear about what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.你做報告或活動時，可以把好點子接成步驟、分工和完成時間。: For a presentation or activity, turn good ideas into steps, shared tasks and completion times.
sentences.展示過後也整理好資料與方法，讓下一次能接著做。: After presenting your work, organise the information and methods too, so you can build on them next time.
sentences.你做功課或活動時，可以先列步驟和完成時間，再按次序做到交付。: For homework or activities, first list the steps and completion times, then work through them in order until the work is ready to hand in.
sentences.做完回看哪一步估得準、哪一步要改，下次的安排就會更實在。: Afterwards, look back at which steps you estimated well and which need adjusting, so your next plan will be more realistic.
sentences.和弟妹或低年級同學相處時，可以把原本的預期和實際情況分開記下；出現落差時，先調整: With younger siblings or pupils, make separate notes of what you expected and what actually happens; if they differ, first adjust your approach and pace, without having to scrap the whole plan at once.
sentences.和弟妹或低年級同學相處時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: With younger siblings or pupils, seek out someone reliable to discuss things with and be clear about what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.你想嘗試新科目或新活動時，可以先完成一個小作品，看看自己喜不喜歡實際做的過程。: If you want to try a new subject or activity, first complete a small piece of work to see whether you enjoy the process of doing it.
sentences.需要轉方向，就把學過的東西和未完的事整理好。: If you need to change direction, organise what you have learnt and anything left unfinished.
sentences.你選課程或活動時，可以先問會學到甚麼、能否持續練習，以及遇到困難由誰指導。: When you choose a course or activity, first ask what you will learn, whether you can keep practising and who will guide you if you have difficulties.
sentences.選一項值得投入的能力，給自己時間累積。: Choose a skill worth working on and give yourself time to build it.
sentences.將來談感情時，可以主動找可靠的人一起商量，並把各自負責的部分說清楚。: In future romantic relationships, seek out someone reliable to discuss things with and be clear about what each of you is responsible for.
sentences.你到新學校或活動時，可以把已有作品和經驗整理好，主動讓老師了解你想學甚麼。: When you join a new school or activity, organise your existing work and experience, and tell your teacher what you want to learn.
sentences.受到肯定後，再找一件可以持續練習的任務。: After your efforts are recognised, find a task you can keep practising.
sentences.你關心低年級同學或後輩時，可以先問他需要方法、物品，還是想找人聽他說。: When you look out for younger pupils or those less experienced than you, first ask whether they need guidance, something to use or someone to listen.
sentences.事情做得好之後，也留意對方有沒有未說出口的困難。: Even after things have gone well, notice whether they have any difficulties they have not mentioned.
sentences.你可以留意自己甚麼時候想和同學相處、甚麼時候想安靜做自己的事。: Notice when you want to spend time with classmates and when you want to do your own things quietly.
sentences.兩種時間都可以安排，也向家人說清楚自己想怎樣休息。: Make room for both, and explain clearly to your family how you would like to rest.
sentences.和弟妹或低年級同學相處時，需要你拿主意的事，先分清哪些自己能決定、哪些要與人商量: With younger siblings or pupils, if a decision falls to you, first work out what you can decide yourself and what you need to discuss with others, so taking the lead does not leave you carrying everything alone.
sentences.你考慮換活動或學習環境時，可以和家人比較兩邊能學到甚麼、有哪些幫助，以及交通和時: If you are thinking of changing activities or where you learn, compare both options with your family: what you can learn, what support is available and how travel and time would be arranged.
sentences.先看真正需要改善哪一點，再作選擇。: First identify what really needs to improve, then make your choice.
sentences.你得到父母或照顧者幫忙時，可以請他們先示範，再讓你自己試下一步。: When your parents or carers help you, ask them to show you first, then let you try the next step yourself.
sentences.做不懂就再問，也把已完成的部分告訴他們，讓他們知道你正在學會。: Ask again if you do not understand how to do it, and tell them which parts you have finished so they know you are learning.
sentences.你身體有不舒服時，可以告訴家人或照顧者哪裡不適、何時開始、有沒有影響活動。: If you feel unwell, tell your family or carer where you feel uncomfortable, when it started and whether it affects your activities.
sentences.反覆或持續不適，就請大人陪你求診，把實際感受說清楚。: If the discomfort keeps coming back or does not go away, ask an adult to go with you to see a doctor and explain clearly how you feel.
sentences.和父母、老師相處時，需要你拿主意的事，先分清哪些自己能決定、哪些要與人商量，讓主: When dealing with your parents or teachers, if a decision falls to you, first work out what you can decide yourself and what you need to discuss with others, so taking the lead does not leave you carrying everything alone.
sentences.你若持續咳嗽，要告訴家人或照顧者已經多久、有沒有其他不舒服。: If your cough does not go away, tell your family or carer how long you have had it and whether anything else feels wrong.
sentences.呼吸困難時，立即向身邊大人求助並及時求醫。: If you have difficulty breathing, ask an adult nearby for help immediately and get medical help promptly.
sentences.處理功課和活動時，需要你拿主意的事，先分清哪些自己能決定、哪些要與人商量，讓主導: For homework and activities, if a decision falls to you, first work out what you can decide yourself and what you need to discuss with others, so taking the lead does not leave you carrying everything alone.
sentences.有一方較擅長推進，也要讓另一方真正參與。: Even if one of you is better at moving things forward, the other still needs a real part in the process.
sentences.和同學、朋友合作時，需要你拿主意的事，先分清哪些自己能決定、哪些要與人商量，讓主: When you work with classmates or friends, if a decision falls to you, first work out what you can decide yourself and what you need to discuss with others, so taking the lead does not leave you carrying everything alone.
sentences.處理功課和活動時，可以把原本的預期和實際情況分開記下；出現落差時，先調整做法和步: For homework and activities, make separate notes of what you expected and what actually happens; if they differ, first adjust your approach and pace, without having to scrap the whole plan at once.
sentences.你安排零用錢、學習用品或共用空間時，可以先照顧好已有的部分，再決定加新東西。: When you manage your pocket money, learning materials or shared space, first look after what you already have, then decide whether to add anything new.
sentences.想增加設備或活動，就和家人一起算時間、費用與誰負責照料，讓得到之後仍能好好使用。: If you want more equipment or activities, work out the time, costs and who will take care of things with your family, so you can keep making good use of them once you have them.
sentences.你帶低年級同學做事時，可以先看對方擅長甚麼，再安排合適任務。: When you guide younger pupils through a task, first see what they are good at, then give them suitable tasks.
sentences.做完一起回看哪裡進步、哪裡要多練，讓能力慢慢累積。: Afterwards, look back together at what has improved and what needs more practice, so their skills can build gradually.
sentences.你若經常肚子不舒服，可以把發作時間和感受告訴家人或照顧者。: If you often have tummy trouble, tell your family or carer when it happens and what it feels like.
sentences.反覆不適時，請大人陪你求診，並一起說清楚飲食與排便的變化。: If it keeps coming back, ask an adult to go with you to see a doctor, and together explain any changes in your eating and toilet habits.
sentences.將來談感情時，可以把原本的預期和實際情況分開記下；出現落差時，先調整做法和步伐，: In future romantic relationships, make separate notes of what you expected and what actually happens; if they differ, first adjust your approach and pace, without having to scrap the whole plan at once.
sentences.和弟妹或低年級同學相處時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就: With younger siblings or pupils, organise your methods, records and other people's comments, so you have clear information to refer to if you need to explain things.
sentences.處理功課和活動時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚的: For homework and activities, organise your methods, records and other people's comments, so you have clear information to refer to if you need to explain things.
sentences.將來談感情時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚的依據: In future romantic relationships, organise your methods, records and other people's comments, so you have clear information to refer to if you need to explain things.
sentences.你同時參加幾項活動時，可以先列出每一項的期限與責任。: If you take part in several activities at once, first list the deadlines and responsibilities for each.
sentences.和老師或組員談好優次，需要交接就提早安排，別讓每件事都只做到一半。: Agree on priorities with your teacher or group members, and arrange any handovers early so you do not leave everything half done.
sentences.你和手足或同學共用活動費或物品時，先說好誰保管、怎樣使用、用完交回哪裡。: If you share activity funds or items with siblings or classmates, first agree on who will keep them, how they will be used and where to return them afterwards.
sentences.安排有變就一起確認，別只靠彼此熟悉便省略交代。: Agree on any changes together, rather than leaving things unexplained just because you know each other well.
sentences.和父母、老師相處時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚: When dealing with your parents or teachers, organise your methods, records and other people's comments, so you have clear information to refer to if you need to explain things.
sentences.將來談感情時，需要你拿主意的事，先分清哪些自己能決定、哪些要與人商量，讓主導不會: In future romantic relationships, if a decision falls to you, first work out what you can decide yourself and what you need to discuss with others, so taking the lead does not leave you carrying everything alone.
sentences.你有反覆痛楚時，要告訴家人或照顧者哪裡痛、甚麼時候會痛。: If you have pain that keeps coming back, tell your family or carer where it hurts and when it happens.
sentences.痛楚持續或影響活動，就請大人陪你尋求醫療評估。: If the pain does not go away or affects your activities, ask an adult to go with you to have it assessed by a medical professional.
sentences.你要換房間、書桌或共用設備時，可以先和家人確認新位置何時能用，再收起舊安排。: If you are changing rooms, desks or shared equipment, first check with your family when the new place will be ready to use, then put away the old set-up.
sentences.每天要用的物品先放好，讓調整期間仍能照常生活和學習。: Put the things you need each day in place first, so daily life and learning can carry on as usual during the change.
sentences.和同學、朋友合作時，可以把做法、紀錄和別人的意見整理好，需要向人說明時，就有清楚: When you work with classmates or friends, organise your methods, records and other people's comments, so you have clear information to refer to if you need to explain things.
sentences.你接下實作任務時，可以先問清楚要完成甚麼、怎樣檢查，以及哪些工具需要老師指導。: When you take on a practical task, first ask what you need to complete, how to check it and which tools you need a teacher's guidance to use.
sentences.做完記下方法和結果，讓下一次能用得上。: Afterwards, note the method and results so you can use them next time.
sentences.你和同學一起做活動時，可以把討論方法與分配物品、費用分開談。: When you do activities with classmates, discuss how to do things separately from how to share items and costs.
sentences.先說好誰保管、誰使用、誰負責交代，避免大家各有理解。: First agree on who will keep things, who will use them and who will account for them, so everyone understands the arrangement in the same way.
sentences.你遇到困難時，可以直接告訴父母或照顧者哪一步做不到、想請他們怎樣幫忙。: If you run into difficulties, tell your parents or carers directly which step you cannot manage and how you would like them to help.
sentences.得到協助後再自己試一次，讓他們知道進展。: After getting help, try again yourself and let them know how you are getting on.
sentences.你到新學校或活動前，可以先了解會用到哪些技能，整理好自己的作品與經驗。: Before you join a new school or activity, find out which skills you will need and organise your work and experience.
sentences.和家人談清楚交通與時間，再逐步熟悉新環境。: Agree on travel and timing with your family, then gradually get to know the new setting.
sentences.羊陀與火星同度及雜曜加入，是逐層增加的配合。: Qing Yang and Tuo Luo sharing a palace with Huo Xing, and the addition of minor stars, add successive layers of conditions.
sentences.你和同學討論問題時，可以先確認要解決甚麼，找到答案就一起記下來。: When you discuss a problem with classmates, first agree on what needs solving, then write down the answer together once you find it.
sentences.討論之外，也留時間做自己喜歡的事。: Leave time outside discussions to do things you enjoy too.
sentences.貪狼化祿的擁戴偏交情，不直接等於權威；火鈴又可以只是人數增加。: The support associated with Tan Lang turning to Abundance is more about personal ties and does not directly amount to authority; Huo Xing or Ling Xing may also simply indicate more people.
sentences.遇到親眷介入時，先問清楚伴侶本人的想法，再一起回應。: If relatives get involved, first ask what your partner thinks, then respond together.
sentences.本宮天府與陀羅同度。: Tian Fu and Tuo Luo share this palace.
sentences.這張盤只確認陀羅，沒有由一項條件便認定整支成立。: Your chart confirms only Tuo Luo here, so this one condition is not taken to establish the whole interpretation.
sentences.你接下小組任務時，可以先看看時間、工具和幫手夠不夠。: Before you take on a group task, check whether you have enough time, tools and help.
sentences.把最先要完成的部分排出來，有困難就及早找老師商量，別把所有要求一次答應。: Set out what needs to be finished first, and speak to a teacher early if there are difficulties, rather than agreeing to every request at once.
sentences.原書以氣痛、胸悶與腹脹作描述，巨門化忌及煞曜又會改變後面的分支。: The book describes gas pains, chest tightness and abdominal bloating, while Ju Men turning to Obstruction and harsh stars further change the interpretations that follow.
sentences.太陽、巨門同宮，原書有吉化下受異族主管提拔的一支，也有化忌時與上司不和的限制。: With Tai Yang and Ju Men sharing a palace, the book gives one interpretation in which favourable transformations bring promotion by a manager of a different nationality or background, but also a qualification that turning to Obstruction brings discord with superiors.
sentences.吉化吉輔的支持支、見煞的限制各自核，不從廉殺認定平輩品格。: Check the supportive interpretation involving favourable transformations and favourable supporting stars separately from the limits associated with harsh stars, without judging the character of your peers from Lian Zhen and Qi Sha.
sentences.武曲化忌另有財務與資源上的說法，仍須通盤條件。: Wu Qu turning to Obstruction has a separate interpretation concerning finances and resources, which still depends on the conditions across your whole chart.
sentences.武曲在本宮化祿，符合原書武殺自行置產分支的重要前提。: Wu Qu turns to Abundance in this palace, meeting an important prerequisite for the book's interpretation of acquiring property through your own efforts with Wu Qu and Qi Sha.
sentences.羊陀與火星同度、武曲化忌及雜曜加入，是逐層增加的配合。: Qing Yang and Tuo Luo sharing a palace with Huo Xing, Wu Qu turning to Obstruction and the addition of minor stars add successive layers of conditions.
sentences.原書明列只見化祿可以是有計劃而未實行，仍要連祿馬等條件看；因此，想改哪裡、準備了: The book explicitly states that turning to Abundance alone may mean having a plan without putting it into practice, and must still be considered alongside conditions such as Lu Cun and Tian Ma; what you want to change, what you have prepared and what you have actually completed are therefore three separate stages.
sentences.書中既談土氣偏重，也留意火鈴與武曲化忌加入後，這條主線如何改變。: The book discusses a predominance of the Earth element and also considers how this main theme changes when Huo Xing or Ling Xing, and Wu Qu turning to Obstruction, join.
sentences.火鈴同度或對沖，再會武曲化忌，是原書另列的一層。: The book lists a further layer where Huo Xing or Ling Xing shares the palace or sits opposite it, with Wu Qu turning to Obstruction also linked.
sentences.紫微、天府同宮，原書要求輔佐支持，紫微化科則重白手創興。: With Zi Wei and Tian Fu sharing a palace, the book requires support from supporting stars, while Zi Wei turning to Recognition emphasises building something from scratch.
sentences.太陰獨坐，原書按日夜、廟陷另論助力，並特別保留太陰化忌而無煞時可能是無心之失。: With Tai Yin as the sole major star, the book assesses support separately according to birth by day or night and the star's strong or weak placement, and specifically allows that Tai Yin turning to Obstruction without harsh stars may indicate an unintentional mistake.
sentences.你的官祿宮在子，天機獨坐，對宮巨門。: Your Career Palace is in Zi, with Tian Ji as its sole major star and Ju Men in the opposite palace.
sentences.工作的重點在回應不同要求、處理變化，轉變之後仍要費心經營；一份工作的日常內容，比: Your work centres on responding to different demands and handling change, with continued care and effort needed afterwards; a job's daily tasks reveal this quality more clearly than its title.
sentences.原書所說的變動，也可以是客戶、任務和環境經常不同，並非每次都要離開原來的工作。: The changes described in the book may also mean frequently changing clients, tasks and surroundings, rather than leaving your existing job every time.
sentences.命宮天同忌會到財帛太陰，求財要勞心勞力；這使官祿的應變不只是一項優點，還包括調整: Tian Tong turning to Obstruction in your Life Palace links with Tai Yin in your Wealth Palace, so earning money takes both mental and physical effort; adaptability in your Career Palace therefore involves not only a strength but also how you keep delivering work and meet ongoing responsibilities after making changes.
sentences.比較工作時，問清楚變動由誰承接、計劃由誰落實，以及自己能否跟進交付。: When you compare jobs, ask who handles changes, who puts plans into practice and whether you can follow the work through to delivery.
sentences.把已做成的方法留下來，再決定下一步怎樣調整，讓每次應變都能累積經驗。: Keep a record of methods that have worked before deciding what to adjust next, so each response to change builds your experience.
sentences.你的福德宮在戌，太陽化祿，鈴星亦在本宮。: Your Wellbeing Palace is in Xu, with Tai Yang turning to Abundance and Ling Xing also in this palace.
sentences.太陽帶活動與追求，鈴星又添了心神難以安定的一面；工作或財路有了進展，未必就容易停: Tai Yang brings activity and ambition, while Ling Xing adds mental restlessness; progress in work or earning money does not necessarily make it easy for you to stop.
sentences.連着官祿的應變與求財的投入看，這一宮要問的，是忙過之後是否真的有滿足，而不只是還: Read alongside the adaptability in your Career Palace and the effort you put into earning money, this palace asks whether you feel satisfied after being busy, rather than simply how much more you could get done.
sentences.福德有龍池、華蓋，又有鳳閣會照，文藝、思想與興趣是這張盤另一條精神投入的線索。: Your Wellbeing Palace contains Long Chi and Hua Gai, with Feng Ge also linked, pointing to the arts, ideas and interests as another source of inner engagement in your chart.
sentences.它可以與工作的成績並存，卻不必每次都拿來衡量產出。: This can sit alongside your achievements at work without having to be measured by output every time.
sentences.做一件自己願意投入的事，與再追下一個目標，是兩種不同的滿足。: Doing something you want to spend time on and pursuing the next goal offer two different kinds of satisfaction.
sentences.替沒有交付要求的興趣留一段時間。: Set aside some time for an interest that does not require you to produce anything.
sentences.忙碌暫停時，把下一步記好，再讓自己離開工作的衡量方式，留意甚麼活動做完後真正覺得: When you pause from being busy, note the next step, then step away from measuring things as you do at work and notice which activities leave you feeling at ease.
sentences.你的官祿宮在卯，天相坐守，重點是受託、協調與體系內的責任。: Your Career Palace is in Mao with Tian Xiang, emphasising work entrusted to you, coordination and responsibilities within an organisation.
sentences.命宮天府與祿存同宮，提供資源管理的支持；工作上承接多少事情，仍要連同能調動多少資: Tian Fu and Lu Cun share your Life Palace, supporting resource management; how much work you take on still needs to be considered alongside the resources you can draw on and the authority you have.
sentences.負責把事情做好，與名義上站在最高位置，是不同的工作要求。: Being responsible for getting things done well and holding the top position in name place different demands on you.
sentences.卯宮天相連到命宮有祿的天府科，原書另列工程技術的工作方向。: With Tian Xiang at Mao linked to Tian Fu turning to Recognition alongside Lu Cun in your Life Palace, the book also lists engineering and technical work as a career direction.
sentences.因此，這張盤不只可談一般管理，還可看較重技術、規範與可核對成果的工作性質。: Your chart can therefore point beyond general management to work that places more emphasis on technical skills, standards and verifiable results.
sentences.前一段的受託與協調，也就有了更具體的內容：怎樣把資源安排成能夠落實的成果。: The entrusted work and coordination described above thus become more concrete: how you organise resources to produce achievable results.
sentences.接下工作前，把責任、決定權、資源與成果標準談清楚。: Before you accept work, agree clearly on responsibilities, decision-making authority, resources and the standards for results.
sentences.評估一個機會時，也看看它能否讓技術與經驗逐步累積，而不只是增加要協調的事情。: When you assess an opportunity, also consider whether it lets you build technical skills and experience gradually, rather than simply adding more things to coordinate.
sentences.你的福德宮在丑，武曲、貪狼同宮，武曲化忌。: Your Wellbeing Palace is in Chou, with Wu Qu and Tan Lang sharing the palace and Wu Qu turning to Obstruction.
sentences.這一支把追求財富與精神享受連在一起；擁有得更多，與得到更多滿足，可以是不同的進度: This interpretation links your pursuit of wealth with inner enjoyment; having more and feeling more satisfied may progress at different rates.
sentences.這張盤較值得留意的，是成果出現之後，自己能否享用它，還是很快又把注意力移到下一個: Your chart particularly invites you to notice whether you can enjoy what you achieve or quickly shift your attention to the next goal.
sentences.喜歡一項活動、願意投入，與投入之後仍有樂趣，要逐層分清。: Distinguish each stage: liking an activity, being willing to put time and effort into it, and still enjoying it afterwards.
sentences.替自己喜歡的活動留時間與預算，也替一個目標訂下完成的尺度。: Set aside time and money for activities you enjoy, and define what will count as completing a goal.
sentences.成果出現時，讓它有被使用和享受的時候，不急着把休息填成另一項追求。: When your efforts bear fruit, give yourself time to use and enjoy the results, without rushing to fill your rest time with another pursuit.
sentences.本盤父母宮在子，天同、太陰與擎羊、火星同宮；天同、太陰本身都沒有本命四化。: Your Parents Palace is in Zi, with Tian Tong, Tai Yin, Qing Yang and Huo Xing sharing the palace; neither Tian Tong nor Tai Yin has any of the four transformations in your birth chart.
sentences.同陰在這裡有感情豐富的一面，羊火同宮亦提醒你留意相處中的分歧。: Tian Tong and Tai Yin bring emotional warmth here, while Qing Yang and Huo Xing sharing the palace also remind you to notice disagreements in your relationships.
sentences.這一宮的重點，是對方的關心、願意幫忙，與是否認同你的決定，未必總是一起出現。: The key point in this palace is that their care, willingness to help and agreement with your decisions may not always come together.
sentences.談到責任、生活安排或重要選擇時，要留意彼此想要的是支援、陪伴，還是對事情有不同安: When you discuss responsibilities, living arrangements or important choices, notice whether each of you wants support or company, or has different arrangements in mind; explaining what you want first makes it easier to identify where you disagree.
sentences.你的官祿宮在寅，本宮沒有主星，借對宮夫妻申的太陽、巨門作參照。: Your Career Palace is in Yin with no major star, so it borrows Tai Yang and Ju Men from the opposite Partnership Palace in Shen as a reference.
sentences.原書的基本性質是口舌、不同背景與對外事務；將來看工作方向，可以先看它是否需要說明: The book's basic themes are speech, different backgrounds and external affairs; when you consider future work, first look at whether it involves explaining, negotiating and connecting different demands, then consider job titles.
sentences.現在做報告或小組討論，也可用來理解表達與推進事情的分別。: Your presentations and group discussions now can also help you understand the difference between expressing ideas and moving things forward.
sentences.命宮機梁要把觀察接到有根據的判斷，官祿陽巨參照則把判斷帶到對外表達；財帛同陰另講: Tian Ji and Tian Liang in your Life Palace call for observations to lead to judgements based on evidence, while Tai Yang and Ju Men as a reference for your Career Palace bring those judgements into communication with others; Tian Tong and Tai Yin in your Wealth Palace separately concern needs, plans and arrangements that allow enjoyment.
sentences.三宮一起讀，重點便不只是說得多不多，而是說明之後，能否讓別人理解事情、知道下一步: Read together, these three palaces focus on more than how much you say: whether your explanation helps others understand the situation and know the next step.
sentences.將來看工作方向時，可以把說明的方式，與最後提供的內容一起衡量。: When you consider future work, weigh up both how you explain things and what you ultimately provide.
sentences.做報告或小組討論時，先整理問題、理由和結論，再說給別人聽。: For a presentation or group discussion, first organise the questions, reasons and conclusions, then explain them to others.
sentences.聽到不同意見，就找出哪一點需要補資料，練習讓大家知道下一步怎樣做。: If you hear a different view, identify which point needs more information and practise helping everyone understand what to do next.
sentences.你的福德宮在子，本宮沒有主星，借對宮財帛午的天同、太陰作參照；擎羊仍實坐福德。: Your Wellbeing Palace is in Zi with no major star, so it borrows Tian Tong and Tai Yin from the opposite Wealth Palace in Wu as a reference; Qing Yang still sits in your Wellbeing Palace itself.
sentences.財帛同陰帶來享用與安排資源的取向，卻不能因此省去本宮多勞的一層。: Tian Tong and Tai Yin in your Wealth Palace bring a focus on enjoyment and organising resources, but this does not remove the extra effort indicated by this palace itself.
sentences.有條件享用，與是否有餘裕享用，須一起看。: You need to consider both whether you have the means to enjoy things and whether you have the time and energy to do so.
sentences.龍池、鳳閣實際會福德，文化、藝術與趣味是另一條精神投入的線索。: Long Chi and Feng Ge do link with your Wellbeing Palace, pointing to culture, art and personal interests as another source of inner engagement.
sentences.財帛天福與天同同度，講的是資源與享用的一面；龍鳳會福，則補充你願意把注意力放在哪: The minor star Tian Fu (the Blessing star) sharing your Wealth Palace with Tian Tong concerns resources and enjoyment, while Long Chi and Feng Ge linking with your Wellbeing Palace add detail about the interests you want to give your attention to.
sentences.休息不只看擁有多少，也看做過一件事之後，是否重新有了心力與樂趣。: Rest depends not only on how much you have, but also on whether an activity leaves you with renewed energy and enjoyment.
sentences.留意哪些活動做完後真正開心，再替它們安排時間。: Notice which activities leave you feeling happy, then make time for them.
sentences.也替睡眠、功課與安靜獨處留位置，讓喜歡的事帶來心力，而不是再多一份要完成的功課。: Leave room for sleep, homework and quiet time on your own too, so the things you enjoy give you energy rather than becoming another piece of homework to finish.
sentences.你的財帛宮在辰，太陰坐守，求財重點在計劃、運用與積聚。: Your Wealth Palace is in Chen with Tai Yin, so earning money centres on planning, using resources and building them up.
sentences.對宮福德太陽化祿，原書把先建立地位、再發展財源列為一般次序。: Tai Yang turns to Abundance in your opposite Wellbeing Palace, and the book gives the general order as establishing your standing first, then developing sources of income.
sentences.放在這張盤，先在工作中累積位置與資源，再看財路怎樣拓展，比只盯着一時收入更能接上: In your chart, first building your standing and resources at work, then looking at how to expand your sources of income, fits the whole picture better than focusing only on immediate earnings.
sentences.命宮天同忌又會財帛太陰，原書明列勞心勞力求財。: Tian Tong turning to Obstruction in your Life Palace also links with Tai Yin in your Wealth Palace, for which the book explicitly describes earning money through both mental and physical effort.
sentences.財路有發展與投入是否輕省，可以同時有不同答案。: Whether your sources of income are growing and whether the effort feels light can have different answers at the same time.
sentences.本宮另有地空同坐。: Di Kong is also in this palace.
sentences.空劫在財帛，原書以突然出現的挫折性變化作主題。: For Di Kong and Di Jie in the Wealth Palace, the book's theme is sudden changes that bring setbacks.
sentences.原有安排需要面對變數，取得資源之後，仍有如何接住改變的一段路。: Your existing arrangements need to cope with uncertainty, and even after you acquire resources, there is still work to do in handling change.
sentences.衡量一項收入時，把需要持續付出的時間、成本與後續責任一起算進去。: When you assess a source of income, include the time, costs and ongoing responsibilities it will continue to require.
sentences.先確認原有安排接得住，再增加新的承擔，讓財路的發展能留下成果。: Check that your existing arrangements can cope before taking on new commitments, so growth in your income can leave lasting results.
sentences.你可以練習一次說清楚一件事，也聽懂對方的需要。: Practise explaining one thing clearly at a time and understanding what your partner needs.
sentences.你要記得為感情交流留時間。: Remember to make time to share your feelings with each other.
sentences.你要留意兩人能否持續為彼此安排時間。: Pay attention to whether you can both keep making time for each other.
sentences.你可以留意兩人怎樣分擔資源、怎樣共同作決定。: Notice how you share resources and make decisions together.
sentences.你可以留意兩人能否一起訂目標、分工與作決定。: Notice whether you can set goals, share tasks and make decisions together.
sentences.你可以記住：家人的意見值得聽，兩人的決定仍要由兩人談妥。: Remember that your family's views deserve a hearing, while decisions for the two of you still need to be agreed between you.
sentences.廉貞、天相同宮，原書即使在有吉化、吉曜時，仍提醒夫妻各懷己見。: With Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang sharing a palace, the book still warns that spouses each hold their own views, even with favourable transformations and favourable stars.
sentences.辰戌太陰與太陽相對，原書雖有長久相處的一般描述，仍列吉曜、煞忌及太陽化忌的修飾。: With Tai Yin opposite Tai Yang across Chen and Xu, the book gives a general description of a lasting relationship but still lists qualifications involving favourable stars, harsh stars and Obstruction, and Tai Yang turning to Obstruction.
sentences.寅申七殺與紫微天府相對，原書另看禄存同度、破軍化祿與輔佐。: With Qi Sha opposite Zi Wei and Tian Fu across Yin and Shen, the book also considers Lu Cun sharing the palace, Po Jun turning to Abundance and supporting stars.
